title: Sr Product Manager EDR
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.
   

  

**The Role**
 Aspen Technology, a business unit inside Emerson Corporation, is a leading industrial software company, serving over 3,000 customers with over $1 billion in annual revenue, more than 60 locations worldwide, and nearly 4,000 employees. AspenTech solutions address complex environments where it is critical to optimize the asset design, operation and maintenance lifecycle.
   

  

 Through AspenTech’s unique combination of deep domain expertise and award\-winning innovative software suites, customers in asset\-intensive industries can improve their operational excellence while achieving sustainability goals.
   

  

 The AspenTech Performance Engineering Solution provides a market leading integrated suite of products to optimize the performance of process industry assets across the CAPEX and OPEX cycles and is powered by flagship process modeling products with a proven track record of value creation over several decades.
   

  

 Aspen Exchanger Design \& Rating (EDR) is a comprehensive heat exchanger modeling and design suite that helps process engineers and equipment manufacturers optimize thermal equipment performance across the asset lifecycle. It delivers customer value through improved engineering productivity, reduced project risk, and lower CAPEX/OPEX via accurate, integrated equipment design and analysis.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 We are seeking an experienced and highly analytical Product Manager to lead the strategy and evolution of our Aspen Exchanger Design and Rating (EDR). In this role, you will define the roadmap for industry\-leading equipment design software used by process engineers and equipment manufacturers globally. You will work at the intersection of complex thermodynamic modeling and modern software development, ensuring our heat exchanger and equipment design solutions integrate seamlessly with broader process simulation workflows (such as Aspen Plus and Aspen HYSYS) while delivering exceptional user experience.
   

  

**Product Vision, Strategy, and Sharp Execution**
* Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for the product, backed by financial assessment such as a business case
* Responsible for Agile roadmap for the product lifecycle (ideation and formation through execution), specifying the positioning, pricing, differentiation, competitive strategy, and definable value and proof points
* Aligns the product vision and strategy to overall Performance Engineering and AspenTech objectives
* Monitor industry trends, competitive developments, and customer requirements.


**Customer Engagement and Customer Centricity**
* Build strong relationships with key customers, industry leaders, and strategic partners.
* Serve as a thought leader and advocate for AspenTech process simulation solutions internally and externally
* Champion customer\-centric product development, balancing market needs, innovation and business objectives.


**Portfolio Ownership and Growth Focus**
* Drive business growth through increased customer adoption, expansion into new markets, and successful introduction of new capabilities.
* Drive innovation initiatives that strengthen competitive differentiation and market leadership, with close collaboration with R\&D and other teams such as AI, UX and other product portfolios
* Support evaluation of potential technology acquisitions and strategic partnerships that can accelerate market growth and product differentiation.
* Partner closely with Product Marketing, Sales, Services, Solution Consulting to drive growth
* Partner with thermal, chemical, and mechanical engineering domain experts to translate complex heat transfer and fluid flow calculation requirements into actionable software features
* Facilitate cross\-functional collaboration and successful outcomes.


 What You'll Need
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field. MBA a plus.
* 10\+ years of experience in enterprise software Product Management, ideally within engineering, simulation, or industrial software domains.
* Strong foundational understanding of process engineering, heat transfer, thermodynamics, or equipment design.
* Experience developing product strategies, business cases, and growth plans for enterprise software products
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate across functions and organizational levels.
* Product Management experience within industrial software, engineering software or process industries.
* Knowledge of Agile product development methodologies.
* Prior hands\-on experience using Aspen EDR, HTRI, and/or other process simulation and heat exchanger rating tools.
* Execution Focus: Knows how to get things done but also has the grit and resilience to drive execution. Pays close attention to detail, and monitors progress well
* Outcome Orientation: This individual will be energized by a challenge and will strive to achieve significant outcomes. Demonstrated ability to successfully introduce new products/services to market that is timely, cost\-effective, and fully meets the needs of the target segment
* Strategic Orientation: The successful candidate will be able to clearly identify and articulate evolving priorities for the business and frame business strategies and strategic direction for his/her area of business, underpinned by intensive market analysis, immediate customer feedback, and competitive analysis to drive solution development.
* Collaborating and Influencing: The successful candidate will communicate with conviction and clarity, whether working with the senior executive team, internal organizations, or customers. He/she will have a natural inclination toward leading through collaboration and seek input and buy\-in from key players across the company. He/she will also demonstrate the personal flexibility to adapt to proven corporate philosophies and practices, as well as contribute new, innovative thinking.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
🚀 We’re Hiring: Senior Product Manager – Mealawe
 



 📍 Pune
 



 💼 Experience: 5–9 Years
 



 💰 CTC: ₹25–35 LPA \+ Attractive ESOPs
 



  





 Mealawe is looking for a Senior Product Manager who can own a consumer product end\-to\-end — from customer insights and competitive analysis to product experience, pricing, P\&L, conversion, retention and growth.
 



 This is not a coordination\-only Product Manager role. We are looking for someone who has already independently owned a consumer\-facing product or business line and is comfortable taking decisions that directly impact customers, revenue, profitability and growth.
 



  





 What You Will Own
 



  





 • End\-to\-end ownership of Mealawe’s customer\-facing digital product
 



 • Product strategy, roadmap and continuous product improvement
 



 • Product P\&L, revenue, margins and unit economics
 



 • Pricing, offers, subscriptions and promotional strategy
 



 • Competitive analysis and market benchmarking
 



 • Customer research, feedback and behavioural analysis
 



 • Improving the complete customer purchase journey across mobile and web
 



 • Product discovery, selection, cart, checkout, payment, repeat purchase and retention
 



 • Identifying customer drop\-offs across the purchase funnel and driving improvements
 



 • Conversion, AOV, repeat rate, retention and customer experience
 



 • Working closely with UI/UX and Design teams to build simple, intuitive and high\-converting customer journeys
 



 • Coordinating closely with Performance Marketing and Growth teams on CAC, ROAS, conversion quality, customer cohorts and funnel performance
 



 • Translating campaign and customer data into product improvements
 



 • Working with Technology teams from problem identification through design, development, launch and post\-launch measurement
 



 • A/B testing across user journeys, pricing, offers, communication, landing pages and checkout flows
 



 • Analysing performance across cities, products, customer segments and acquisition channels
 



 • Identifying underperforming areas of the product and driving corrective action
 



 • Building dashboards and review mechanisms for faster decision\-making
 



 • Presenting product performance, customer insights, problems and action plans directly to senior leadership
 



  





 We Are Specifically Looking For
 



  





 ✅ 5–9 years of total professional experience
 



 ✅ Minimum 5 years of relevant Product Management / Consumer Product / Business Product experience
 



 ✅ At least 1 year of independent ownership of a product or business line
 



 ✅ B2C or D2C experience is mandatory
 



 ✅ Hands\-on experience managing a customer\-facing mobile app or web product where users discover, select and purchase products or services online
 



 ✅ Strong understanding of the complete consumer transaction funnel:
 



 Traffic → Landing → Discovery → Selection → Cart → Checkout → Payment → Repeat → Retention
 



 ✅ Candidates currently working in B2C/D2C will be strongly preferred
 



 ✅ Previous B2B experience is acceptable if your current/recent experience is strongly B2C/D2C focused
 



 ✅ Minimum 2–3 years in a startup, scale\-up or high\-velocity organisation
 



 ✅ Strong experience with P\&L, unit economics and profitability
 



 ✅ Hands\-on understanding of pricing, competition, customer behaviour and commercial metrics
 



 ✅ Experience working closely with Performance Marketing / Growth teams
 



 ✅ Experience collaborating with UI/UX, Product Design and Technology teams
 



 ✅ Strong data\-driven decision\-making ability
 



  





 Relevant Backgrounds
 



  





 We would particularly like to meet candidates from:
 



 Consumer Internet \| Food\-Tech \| Quick Commerce \| E\-commerce \| Marketplaces \| D2C \| Subscription Businesses \| Consumer Apps
 



  





 Experience in a high\-frequency transactional product — where customers regularly browse, purchase, pay and return — will be highly relevant.
 



  





 What Will Make You Stand Out
 



  





 You should be able to demonstrate measurable examples where you have:
 



 • Improved revenue or contribution margin
 



 • Improved conversion or retention
 



 • Built or scaled a consumer digital product
 



 • Improved product discovery, cart, checkout or payment journeys
 



 • Changed pricing or offers based on data
 



 • Reduced customer drop\-offs in the purchase funnel
 



 • Improved repeat purchase or subscription behaviour
 



 • Identified competitive gaps and acted on them
 



 • Worked with Performance Marketing to improve acquisition quality or conversion
 



 • Worked with UI/UX teams to materially improve customer experience
 



 • Built and measured successful product experiments
 



 • Turned around an underperforming consumer product or funnel
 



  





 What Success Looks Like
 



  





 You should be able to answer questions such as:
 



 Why are customers dropping between landing and purchase?
 



 Which part of the app or web journey needs improvement?
 



 What are competitors doing better?
 



 Are we priced correctly?
 



 Which offers are actually improving incremental revenue?
 



 Why are some marketing campaigns bringing better customers than others?
 



 How can we improve conversion without destroying margins?
 



 How can we increase repeat purchase and retention?
 



 What should UI/UX, Technology and Performance Marketing teams work on next — and why?
 



 You will be expected to move from:
 



 Data → Insight → Decision → Execution → Measurement
 



  





 What We Offer
 



  





 💰 ₹25–35 LPA
 



 📈 Attractive ESOPs
 



 🎯 Significant product ownership and decision\-making responsibility
 



 🚀 Opportunity to directly influence product, customer experience, growth and business economics
 



 🤝 Direct exposure to senior leadership and high\-impact business decisions
 



  





 If you enjoy working at the intersection of Product \+ Consumer Behaviour \+ P\&L \+ Growth \+ Performance Marketing \+ UI/UX \+ Technology, we would like to hear from you.
 



 Apply through LinkedIn or share your profile with us.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Zendesk builds AI powered, customizable and simple to use service software crafted to improve customer relationships. Many of the world’s favorite brands leverage our products to engage you as a customer. We lead the industry with beautifully simple software, and you’ve almost certainly interacted with it without knowing it!**
**We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead our Strategic Integrations and Connections capabilities which are used to connect, sync, and orchestrate across Zendesk and other systems.**
**In this role will have significant direct interaction with customers, partners, and executive sponsors. You will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams; engineering, design, product marketing, sales, and tech alliances to build and launch solutions. This position is well suited to an individual who has experience building partnerships to launch joint solutions. You are excellent at building relationships with stakeholders both inside and outside the org chart. Success in this role will be driven by your ability to balance priorities, manage expectations, rapidly execute on initiatives that meet customer needs, operate across many geographical distributed stakeholders, and work productively with external partners.**
****As a Senior Product Manager for Strategic Integrations and Connections you’ll…****
* Be capable of working without direction or regular oversight. You’re already experienced in the discipline of product management and comfortable leading product delivery teams, making decisions, and reporting back to leadership. You know what needs to be done and you’re independent and self\-driven enough to do it.
* Be a subject matter expert in your product area, and work with customers to further understand their needs and develop that expertise
* Be a strategic leader for this area, setting and articulating a vision and roadmap on which integrations to invest and divest.
* Work with Tech Alliances and partners to identify opportunities to grow partnerships and build solutions that create co\-marketing moments and solve joint\-customer’s problems
* Drive the direction of new capabilities and enhancements with engineering and design partners, ensuring that solutions built adequately capture the opportunity and solve the customer need. You don’t own the delivery, but you drive it.
* Where necessary, interact with executives to respond to customer escalations. Attend customer meetings with those executives and de\-escalate situations through your calm and controlled demeanor, bringing a plan to resolve issues and build trust and confidence with customers and executives.
* Possess exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to, champion and shape organizational decisions using your words and influence.
* Define OKRs, success metrics and review performance against those.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree, with 5 years of Product Management experience under your belt, delivering products that met business goals.
* Your work experience will include customer\-focused SaaS, designing and shipping “full\-stack” from front\-end, to back\-end, and APIs.
* A great collaborator that knows that to deliver anything of value is a team effort and likes to dig in with intelligent and passionate engineers to find the best solution to a problem.
* Ability to understand complex systems, and balance appropriate tradeoffs between performance, cost, and user experience.
* A self\-starter with a bias for action who is motivated to solve problems and deliver results with an owner mentality.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills for varying audiences: customers, engineering, marketing, program management, and executives.
* The drive to deeply understand our product, the market, our customers, and when to use the right data to measure success, using analytics tools to aid in decision\-making.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* The SCRUM team in this role is based in Melbourne and Pune, so experience product managing a geographically distributed engineering team will be helpful.


 Please note that Zendesk can only hire candidates who are physically located and plan to work from Karnataka or Maharashtra. Please refer to the location posted on the requisition for where this role is based.
   

  

 Hybrid: In this role, our hybrid experience is designed at the team level to give you a rich onsite experience packed with connection, collaboration, learning, and celebration \- while also giving you flexibility to work remotely for part of the week. This role must attend our local office for part of the week. The specific in\-office schedule is to be determined by the hiring manager.

 Zendesk software was built to bring a sense of calm to the chaotic world of customer service. Today we power billions of conversations with brands you know and love.

The MRD organization works in partnership with data clients across global business lines, deploying solutions to increase competitiveness through restructuring business processes, simplifying information access, and providing business intelligence around critical data.
   

  

 The Technology Product Management Lead Analyst is a senior individual contributor (IC) position responsible for liaising between senior business users, operations leads, and technologists to define product vision, drive product roadmaps, manage backlogs, and lead platform enhancements. The overall objective of this role is to provide thought leadership, drive continuous exploration, advance data quality and capabilities, and maximize business value and platform adoption.
   

  

**Team Overview**
 This Corporate Actions Product \& Data Team works on a global strategic technology platform \- Global Corporate Action Event Repository. Major tasks involve \- processing Vendor Data Feeds, Analyzing and Researching Data, Working on Swift Messages, User Interface, Data publishing to downstream clients (via Cloud, custom publisher), Rules and Governance, Audit, Compliance. Coverage, Completeness, Accuracy, and Timeliness of information are the key drivers. Client and User requirements drive the overall product roadmap. It is a global team.

* Lead Business and Functional Requirements, Epics, and User Stories for complex Corporate Action initiatives
* Drive Product Backlog management, refinement, and sprint prioritization

* Work closely with stakeholders – Clients across lines of businesses, Operational partners, IT, PMO

* Lead engagements with Data Providers and Vendors (Internal \& External)

* Strong analytical skills, with extensive experience in documenting functional/technical specifications, epics, and user stories

title: Product Consultant(T)
description:
**Job Summary**
 This hybrid role for an experienced product consultant focuses on designing enhancing and supporting manufacturing execution and billing solutions using C sharp Angular JS SQL scripting and Critical Manufacturing MES. The consultant will work in day shifts with no travel required engaging closely with stakeholders to optimize invoice adjustment and customer billing processes while ensuring operational efficiency and business value.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead end to end product consulting activities for manufacturing execution solutions by leveraging C sharp Angular JS and SQL scripting to deliver robust and scalable applications that optimize production performance and transactional accuracy.
* Drive detailed requirement discovery sessions with business stakeholders in customer billing and invoice adjustment domains to translate complex operational needs into clear product features and technical specifications within Critical Manufacturing MES.
* Design and configure MES workflows and data models that integrate seamlessly with authorization billing and invoice adjustment processes to improve accuracy turnaround time and compliance across large scale manufacturing environments.
* Develop high quality software components using C sharp and Angular JS that support intuitive user interfaces and reliable backend services enabling efficient management of customer billing events and adjustment authorizations.
* Create optimized SQL scripts and database procedures that ensure data integrity performance and traceability for transactions related to customer invoices adjustments and billing authorizations within enterprise systems.
* Collaborate closely with cross functional teams including business analysts architects and operations specialists to prioritize product backlog items that deliver measurable impact on revenue assurance and manufacturing efficiency.
* Provide expert guidance on the use of Critical Manufacturing MES capabilities such as production modeling data collection and integration interfaces to enhance visibility across the authorise customer billing and invoice adjustment lifecycle.
* Conduct rigorous testing validation and defect resolution activities for MES and billing related solutions ensuring that product enhancements meet quality standards regulatory requirements and organizational performance targets.
* Mentor junior consultants and technical team members in best practices for product configuration coding standards and solution troubleshooting to build a strong delivery culture and sustain operational excellence.
* Prepare detailed functional and technical documentation for MES configurations application components and SQL scripts so that support teams can maintain and evolve solutions with minimal disruption to business operations.
* Engage in continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing system usage metrics billing accuracy trends and production performance indicators to propose product changes that enhance customer satisfaction and societal value through efficient manufacturing.
* Support stakeholders during go live and post implementation phases by resolving complex incidents performing root cause analysis and recommending preventive actions that stabilize billing and manufacturing execution processes.
* Coordinate with security and compliance teams to ensure that MES and billing solutions adhere to organizational policies data protection standards and audit requirements while maintaining usability and process efficiency.


**Qualifications**
* Bring nine to twelve years of progressive experience in product consulting or solution implementation with a focus on complex manufacturing and billing environments supported by large scale enterprise systems.
* Demonstrate strong hands on proficiency in C sharp including object oriented design patterns integration techniques and performance tuning practices relevant for production grade applications.
* Exhibit advanced capability in Angular JS for building responsive secure and maintainable front end interfaces that enable efficient execution of manufacturing and billing tasks by diverse user groups.
* Apply deep knowledge of SQL scripting and relational database concepts to design queries procedures and optimization strategies that support high volume transaction processing and analytical reporting.
* Show proven experience working with Critical Manufacturing MES including configuration integration and customization to align production workflows with customer billing and invoice adjustment requirements.
* Display solid understanding of authorize customer billing and invoice adjustment domain processes including validation controls exception handling and reconciliation practices across enterprise operations.
* Operate effectively in hybrid work settings demonstrating strong communication collaboration and documentation skills that ensure smooth coordination across onsite and remote stakeholders.

description:

 Are you looking for a high\-impact career move that places you at the heart of global securities market infrastructure? Bring your expertise in technology strategy, portfolio governance, and investment planning to
 **Citi’s Global Custody Team** 
 .
   

  

 By joining Citi, you will become an integral part of a global organization whose mission is to serve as a trusted partner to institutional clients by responsibly providing financial and custody services that enable growth, operational resilience, and market connectivity
   

  

**Team \& Role Overview**
 The
 **Investment Planning and Portfolio Oversight** 
 role sits within the Custody Business Execution team, and as part of the broader Investor Services business in Citi.
   

  

 This role is responsible for managing the technology budgeting process for the Custody business and overseeing the execution of the change book of work.
   

  

 It covers the full scope of the Custody Product set – Transaction Management, Asset Servicing, FX, Cash, Digital Assets, Tax and Business Services
   

  

 Custody sits within
 **Investor Services** 
 , part of
 **Services** 
 —one of the primary core business lines at Citi. Serving institutional clients across more than 95 markets and operating the industry’s largest proprietary custody network in over 60 markets, Services provides integrated payments and collections, liquidity management, trade services, securities custody, fund administration, and issuer solutions to sovereign wealth funds, asset managers, banks, broker\-dealers, and multinational corporations worldwide.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 As the Custody Investment Planning and Portfolio Oversight Lead, you will drive the end\-to\-end global technology investment portfolio for Custody. You will serve as the primary liaison between Custody Product, Operations, Technology, Finance and Investor Services to ensure that multi\-million\-dollar technology investments deliver strategic differentiation, regulatory compliance, risk mitigation, an improved client experience and strong commercial ROI.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Lead Annual Technology Investment Planning: Drive the annual and multi\-year technology book of work (BoW) planning cycle for Custody, establishing and managing a transparent and rigorous investment prioritization framework.
* ROI Tracking \& Portfolio Governance: Implement structured governance forums, scorecard metrics, and financial oversight to track project delivery against budget, monitor capitalization vs. expense burn, and measure post\-implementation commercial/productivity ROI.
* Business Case Formulation \& Appraisal: Partner with Custody Product Managers and Operations Leads to build robust, quantitative business cases and benefits\-realization plans for platform modernization, process automation, digital assets capabilities, and market infrastructure mandates
* Strategic Prioritization \& Risk Reduction: Balance discretionary investments against mandatory/regulatory programs, prioritizing initiatives that optimize asset safety, mitigate operational and counterparty risks, and improve straight\-through processing (STP) rates.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Act as the trusted advisor and central point of coordination for senior business heads across Custody Product, Technology leads, Finance, Operations and the Investor Services team.
* Own the Custody Strategic Investment Story: Help craft the Custody investment thesis, and ensure it propagates through to the execution book of work – top down strategy alignment with bottoms up tech spend.


**What We’ll Need From You**
**Qualifications \& Experience:**
* 10\+ years of relevant experience in Financial Services, Securities Services/Custody, or Management Consulting with a focus on Technology Strategy, Investment Portfolio Governance, or Transformation Execution.
* Custody Knowledge: Strong understanding of the Investor Services business – including Global Custody, Direct Custody and post\-trade settlement cycles.
* Portfolio \& Financial Governance: Demonstrated track record in managing large\-scale technology investment budgets, business case evaluations, cost\-benefit analyses, and Capex allocation models.
* Transformation \& Architecture Methodologies: Experience with business capability modeling, target state architecture design, and process mapping frameworks. Agile experience preferable.
* Executive Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication, storytelling, and consensus\-building skills with proven ability to influence senior C\-suite and managing director\-level stakeholders across Product, Technology, and Operations in a matrixed environment.
* Agility \& Analytical Rigour: Strong problem\-solving abilities with experience managing competing priorities under tight delivery and regulatory deadlines.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Business Administration, or equivalent practical experience.
* Digital and AI native: Embrace new and improved ways of working, putting AI\-capabilities at the centre of a process improvement agenda


**What We Can Offer You**

* Direct involvement in shaping the multi\-year technology roadmap for a market\-leading securities services provider.

 The Category Manager – Orthopedic Power Systems will be responsible for building, managing, and growing Manman’s Orthopedic Power Systems business as an independent strategic category.
   

  

 The role will own the complete category lifecycle — from market intelligence, product strategy and portfolio planning to pricing, sales enablement, channel development, marketing, product launches, inventory planning and profitability.
   

  

 The individual will act as the central interface between R\&D, Engineering, Production, Quality \& Regulatory, Sales, Service, Marketing, Finance and Supply Chain, ensuring that the Orthopedic Power Systems portfolio remains clinically relevant, commercially competitive and financially successful.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should combine strong orthopedic product knowledge with commercial and business\-development capability.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 2\. Key Responsibilities
   

  

 A. Category Strategy \& Business Ownership
   

  

 \- Develop and execute the annual and long\-term strategy for the Orthopedic Power Systems category.
   

 \- Own category revenue, gross margin, market share and growth objectives.
   

 \- Develop annual business plans covering:
   

 \- Revenue
   

 \- Unit volumes
   

 \- ASP
   

 \- Gross margin
   

 \- Product mix
   

 \- Channel mix
   

 \- Geographic expansion
   

 \- Identify new market opportunities, customer segments and applications for orthopedic power systems.
   

 \- Develop category growth strategies for India and selected international markets.
   

 \- Track competitors, pricing, technology, product launches and market positioning.
   

 \- Identify gaps in Manman’s portfolio and recommend new products or product variants.
   

  

 B. Product Portfolio Management
   

  

 Own the complete Orthopedic Power Systems portfolio, including relevant:
   

  

 \- High\-speed drill systems
   

 \- Large\-bone systems
   

 \- Small\-bone systems
   

 \- Saw systems
   

 \- Oscillating/sagittal saws
   

 \- Reciprocating saws
   

 \- Shaver systems
   

 \- Endoscopic burr systems
   

 \- Attachments
   

 \- Handpieces
   

 \- Accessories
   

 \- Consumables

 \- Related service and AMC offerings
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Define product positioning and target customer for each product.
   

 \- Maintain the product portfolio and product lifecycle.
   

 \- Identify products requiring upgrades, replacement or discontinuation.
   

 \- Develop product roadmaps in coordination with R\&D and Engineering.
   

 \- Define product specifications based on market and clinical requirements.
   

 \- Gather voice\-of\-customer and surgeon feedback.
   

 \- Convert clinical requirements into clear product requirements for Engineering/R\&D.
   

  

 C. Product Development \& New Product Introduction
   

  

 \- Prepare Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) for new products.

 \- Develop launch plans for new products.
   

 \- Establish product readiness gates before commercial launch.
   

 \- Coordinate first production, field trials and commercial release.
   

  

 D. Pricing \& Commercial Management
   

  

 \- Develop product pricing strategy based on:

 \- Competitor pricing
   

 \- Clinical value
   

 \- Channel margins
   

 \- Customer segment
   

 \- Market positioning
   

 \- Recommend MRP, distributor/dealer pricing and institutional pricing.

 \- Develop tender and institutional pricing frameworks.
   

 \- Identify opportunities to improve category gross margin.
   

 \- Monitor profitability by product, customer segment and channel.
   

  

 E. Sales Enablement
   

  

 Work closely with the Sales team to increase conversion and category penetration.
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Develop sales presentations and product literature.
   

 \- Create product comparison sheets.
   

 \- Develop competitive battle cards.
   

 \- Conduct regular product training for sales teams and distributors.
   

 \- Train sales personnel on clinical applications and product positioning.
   

 \- Support major customer meetings, product demonstrations and evaluations.
   

 \- Participate in important tenders and institutional negotiations.
   

 \- Support the sales team in converting strategic accounts.
   

  

 F. Surgeon \& Key Opinion Leader Engagement
   

  

 Build strong relationships with orthopedic surgeons, hospitals and clinical experts.
   

  

 \- Identify and develop Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs).
   

 \- Conduct surgeon feedback programs.
   

 \- Organize product demonstrations and workshops.
   

 \- Coordinate product evaluations at hospitals.
   

 \- Gather structured feedback on product performance and clinical usability.
   

 \- Identify emerging surgical techniques and applications.
   

 \- Develop surgeon advisory panels where appropriate.
   

 \- Convert clinical feedback into product\-development priorities.
   

  

 G. Channel \& Market Development
   

  

 \- Develop strategies for direct, dealer and distributor channels.
   

 \- Identify and onboard suitable channel partners.
   

 \- Define territory\-wise category opportunities.
   

 \- Develop distributor sales targets and business plans.
   

 \- Monitor distributor inventory and secondary sales.
   

 \- Identify underpenetrated states and territories.
   

 \- Support international expansion of the category where required.
   

 \- Develop market\-entry plans for new countries.
   

  

 H. Marketing \& Category Communication
   

  

 Work with the Marketing team to build the Orthopedic Power Systems brand and category.
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Develop category positioning and messaging.
   

 \- Plan product launches and campaigns.
   

 \- Create clinical and technical marketing content.
   

 \- Develop brochures, catalogues, videos and digital content.
   

 \- Support exhibitions, conferences and workshops.
   

 \- Plan surgeon engagement activities.
   

 \- Develop product demonstrations and educational material.
   

 \- Measure marketing effectiveness and lead conversion.
   

  

 I. Demand Planning \& Inventory
   

  

 Work closely with Sales, Production and Supply Chain to ensure the right product availability.
   

  

 \- Prepare monthly and annual demand forecasts.
   

 \- Translate sales plans into SKU\-level forecasts.
   

 \- Monitor inventory levels and ageing.
   

 \- Identify slow\-moving and obsolete inventory.
   

 \- Coordinate production planning based on demand.
   

 \- Ensure availability of critical handpieces, attachments, batteries and consumables.
   

 \- Monitor forecast accuracy.
   

 \- Work towards improving inventory turns and working capital efficiency.
   

  

 J. Service \& Product Lifecycle Management
   

  

 Work closely with the Service team to improve customer experience and product lifecycle economics.
   

  

 \- Analyse field failures and service complaints.
   

 \- Identify recurring product issues.
   

 \- Coordinate corrective actions with Engineering and Quality.
   

 \- Monitor warranty claims.
   

 \- Develop AMC/service opportunities.
   

 \- Identify opportunities for refurbishment, upgrades and replacement sales.
   

 \- Track installed base and replacement cycles.
   

 \- Develop strategies for consumable and accessory attachment.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 3\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

 The Category Manager will be evaluated on measurable business outcomes including:
   

  

 Commercial
   

  

 \- Category revenue growth
   

 \- Unit sales growth
   

 \- Gross margin
   

 \- Average selling price
   

 \- Price realization
   

 \- Product mix
   

 \- New customer acquisition
   

  

 Market
   

  

 \- Market share growth
   

 \- Number of active hospitals
   

 \- Number of active surgeons/users
   

 \- Geographic penetration
   

 \- Dealer/distributor productivity
   

  

 Product
   

  

 \- New product launches
   

 \- Launch success
   

 \- Product adoption
   

 \- Product lifecycle management
   

 \- Customer satisfaction
   

 \- Product quality feedback
   

  

 Channel
   

  

 \- Active distributors/dealers
   

 \- Distributor sales
   

 \- Secondary sales
   

 \- Dealer productivity
   

 \- Channel inventory
   

  

 Operational
   

  

 \- Forecast accuracy
   

 \- Inventory turns
   

 \- Slow\-moving inventory
   

 \- Product availability
   

 \- Warranty/service performance
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 4\. Cross\-Functional Responsibilities
   

  

 The Category Manager will work closely with:
   

  

 Function\| Primary Interaction
   

 Sales\| Revenue, pipeline, product conversion
   

 Marketing\| Category positioning and campaigns
   

 R\&D / Engineering\| Product development and roadmap
   

 Production\| Costing, capacity and product availability
   

 Quality \& Regulatory\| Compliance and product approvals
   

 Service\| Installed base, failures and lifecycle
   

 Supply Chain\| Forecasting and inventory
   

 Finance\| Pricing, margins and profitability
   

 Management\| Category strategy and business reviews
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 5\. Candidate Profile
   

  

 Education
   

  

 Preferred:
   

  

 \- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Life Sciences, Pharmacy or a related discipline.
   

 \- MBA in Marketing, Product Management or Business Management will be an advantage.
   

  

 Experience
   

  

 5–10 years of relevant experience, preferably in:
   

  

 \- Orthopedic medical devices
   

 \- Surgical instruments
   

 \- Orthopedic power tools
   

 \- Neurosurgical power tools
   

 \- Surgical equipment
   

 \- Medical device product management
   

 \- Medical device sales/business development
   

  

 Candidates with strong experience in orthopedic power tools, surgical drills, saws, shavers or related capital equipment will be preferred.
   

  

 Required Skills
   

  

 \- Strong understanding of orthopedic surgical procedures and applications.
   

 \- Product management experience.
   

 \- Commercial and business\-development orientation.
   

 \- Strong analytical and market\-research capabilities.
   

 \- Understanding of medical\-device distribution.
   

 \- Pricing and margin management.
   

 \- Excellent presentation and communication skills.
   

 \- Ability to interact confidently with orthopedic surgeons.
   

 \- Ability to work with engineering and technical teams.
   

 \- Strong negotiation skills.
   

 \- Willingness to travel extensively.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 6\. Desired Personal Attributes
   

  

 The ideal candidate should be:
   

  

 \- Commercially aggressive but analytically driven
   

 \- Customer and surgeon focused
   

 \- Strong in ownership and execution
   

 \- Comfortable working with ambiguity
   

 \- Data driven
   

 \- Curious about technology
   

 \- Strong at cross\-functional coordination
   

 \- Able to understand both clinical and commercial requirements
   

 \- Comfortable presenting to senior management
   

 \- Willing to spend significant time in the field
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 7\. What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Within the first 12 months, the Category Manager should be able to:
   

  

 1\. Establish a clear strategy for the Orthopedic Power Systems category.
   

 2\. Build a comprehensive competitor and market map.
   

 3\. Define the product portfolio and product roadmap.
   

 4\. Establish SKU\-level sales and demand forecasts.
   

 5\. Improve sales\-team product capability.
   

 6\. Build a structured surgeon/KOL engagement program.
   

 7\. Improve product conversion and market penetration.
   

 8\. Identify new product and portfolio opportunities.
   

 9\. Improve category gross margins and price realization.
   

 10\. Establish a measurable category review system with monthly business dashboards.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 8\. Role Philosophy
   

  

 This is not a conventional Product Manager role.
   

  

 The Category Manager is expected to operate as the business owner of Orthopedic Power Systems, with responsibility extending beyond product specifications into revenue, profitability, market development, customer adoption and portfolio growth.
   

  

 The role requires an individual who can move seamlessly between a surgeon discussion in the morning, a product\-development meeting in the afternoon and a commercial/business review with management in the evening.

title: Product Owner
description:
**Department:** 
 Development

 Permanent \- Full Time
   

  

**Location:** 
 Pune, India

 Ankur Chourey
   

  

**Description**
**Role overview**
 We are seeking a Technical Product Owner with an understanding of SaaS platforms, Azure cloud with an opportunity to work with API\-driven architectures, customer specific backend applications running, third\-party integrations, data pipelines, and analytics, capable of managing a complex ecosystem of 30\+ applications and driving product across business and engineering teams.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Product Owner who will champion the value provided through a product (or product components), ensuring the solution solves a defined problem, and fulfils its objectives at a feature and system level. You will work within a cross\-functional team to design and define products that reflect the business and product vision, and developing a path to iteratively execute on that vision, collaborating closely with the Product Manager regarding scope, and Delivery managers, Developers, \& QA to implement and test.
   

  

 As such you will be a good listener, storyteller and influencer with strong communication skills.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Working with the Product Manager, you will be responsible for understanding and breaking the vision into executable goals, driven by the value to be created, that can be achieved in an iterative manner within your team
* Maximise the value addition to the products
* Use a variety of approaches and techniques (e.g. user journeys, process mapping, use cases) to understand and communicate requirements
* Where necessary, translate external technical requirements and specifications and articulate these into detailed user stories underpinned by a sound understanding of the business objectives
* Own and evolve the team backlog, ensuring it is detailed, prioritised, well understood, up to date, properly estimated, relevant to delivery time scales. Collaborate with your team to write and manage user stories through to production
* Communicate proficiently with the development team to explain the product features that are to be implemented
* Collaborate within a cross\-functional team, listening, facilitating and contributing to drive a common purpose, make decisions and achieve goals as an empowered, autonomous team
* Map and comprehend risks in delivering against goals alongside the Delivery Manager, reducing and resolving them where possible
* Develop an understanding of the relevant customer and market needs for your product, and consistently reflect these within the team
* Use domain modelling to design systems for maintainability, testability and incremental development, by understanding and describing entities and the relationships between them
* Provide data driven analysis, communicating the pros and cons, plus short\- and long\-term implications to make decisions in team
* Ensure that the product is compliant with all relevant regulations and standards, and managing any legal or ethical considerations relating to the product
* Continuously promote best product practises to foster new ways of working and ensure we deliver successful products


 Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
   

  

* 10\-12 years experience managing and continuously developing software products.
* Ability to translate product vision into executable goals and delivery plans.
* Experience owning and prioritizing product backlogs.
* Strong user story creation, refinement, and backlog management.
* Ability to maximize product value and focus on customer outcomes.
* Experience working closely with Product Managers and cross\-functional teams.
* Strong experience in Agile and Lean product development.
* Experience facilitating Agile ceremonies.
* Ability to work in customer\-centric, data\-driven, cross\-functional teams.
* Capability to coach and promote Agile/Product best practices.


* Expertise in requirements gathering and documentation.

+ Use cases

* Ability to convert complex business and technical requirements into actionable user stories.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to influence decision\-making and resolve conflicting viewpoints.

+ Third\-party integrations

title: Product Intelligence, Launch & Adoption Lead
description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
 QAD is building a world\-class SaaS company, and we are growing. We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real\-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain.
   

  

**This hybrid position requires candidates to be based in Pune with 3\-4 days of in\-office collaboration per week.**
**Job Description**
 QAD is hiring a senior operator to own three connected things: how we measure whether our products are working, how we launch new products into the market, and how we keep them adopted once they're live.
   

  

 The role owns the metrics layer across our product portfolio — telemetry, adoption analytics, value realization — and runs the operational mechanics of every product launch. After launch, you're the person who notices when usage decays, diagnoses why, and routes the fix to the right team. You'll partner closely with the Customer Success organization, which executes the customer\-facing side of adoption work under your diagnostic direction.
   

  

 This is the most operationally demanding seat on the Product Operations team and the one with the most cross\-functional surface area. It reports to the Head of Product Operations.
   

  

 What you'll own
   

  

* Own KPI governance and the metrics layer: workflow telemetry, adoption analytics, product\-health dashboards, decision outcomes vs. baseline. Standardize dual success metrics across the portfolio (product outcomes and model metrics) so teams know what "good enough" means at each capability tier.
* Own value\-realization tracking: prove ROI per launched product at the customer level. This evidence does two jobs — it informs stage\-gate decisions, and it underwrites the case for continued investment in the new product portfolio.
* Run NPI launch mechanics: launch readiness, enablement materials, sales and customer success playbooks, pricing\-and\-packaging coordination per product, and the cross\-functional launch calendar.
* Own adoption health monitoring across the entire shipped portfolio. Maintain the leading\-indicator dashboard. When sustained usage decay is flagged (with thresholds defined per product), trigger the adoption response protocol within 48 hours: pull evaluation signals, value\-realization data, and field notes; diagnose the root cause; route to the right owner.
* Be the single accountable owner of root\-cause diagnosis when adoption drops. Route product gaps to the product team, enablement gaps to Customer Success, and customer\-fit issues to the field deployment team. Customer Success executes the human\-side fix; you stay accountable for the signal and the routing.
* Run PM enablement: AI\-native methodology, templates, the experimentation cadence, and the training that helps product managers evolve into operators of AI\-powered products. Partner closely with the AI Quality \& Evaluation Lead so PM training on evaluation\-writing is integrated, not bolted on.
* Standardize the intake process for user feedback, feature requests, and field signals, and own the core product\-ops tool stack.


**Qualifications**
 What we're looking for
   

  

* 5\-8 years in product ops, product launch/GTM operations, customer\-success operations, or product analytics — with demonstrated ownership of at least two of the three (launch, analytics, adoption).
* Hands\-on experience launching products in a multi\-SKU enterprise environment; bonus if you've owned a post\-launch adoption motion working with a separate Customer Success team.
* Strong analytics: dashboards, partnering with data teams to build self\-serve analytics for product managers, SQL and spreadsheet automation expected.
* Strong facilitator who can hold a cross\-functional diagnostic conversation. The job is calling the right meeting at the right time and making sure the right four humans are in it.
* Backbone, in a different flavor than the Head's. You will need to tell Customer Success leadership "this is not an enablement problem, please don't run that playbook" — and be right.
* Curiosity about the AI landscape; you don't need to build evaluations but you need to read them.


**Additional Information**
* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work\-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard\-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea\-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set


**About QAD**
 QAD \| Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD \| Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.
   

  

 QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.
   

  

 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

title: Product Engineering Leader
description:
**Position Summary:** 




 This role is for a product engineering leader who will lead Japan Core Insurance Systems (CIS) delivery from MGCC, India, and drive a broad Quality Engineering and QA automation transformation. The leader is expected to be AI\-first in engineering practice: shaping the Agentic Development Lifecycle (ADLC), embedding AI and automation into SDLC/ADLC workflows, and building or contributing to agentic platforms, engineering agents, testing agents, and reusable accelerators that improve speed, quality, predictability, and developer experience.
 



  





**Role positioning:** 
 Insurance, policy administration, or PAS exposure is useful but optional. The primary requirement is proven product engineering leadership with hands\-on, AI\-first transformation across engineering and quality.
 



  





**Scope \& Business Impact:** 



* Lead Japan CIS delivery, operational stability, quality outcomes, and financial governance from MGCC, India.
* Drive AI\-first engineering practices across delivery, quality engineering, release readiness, and production stability.
* Lead the QA automation and Quality Engineering transformation for Japan technology deliverables.
* Establish agentic SDLC/ADLC patterns that improve developer productivity, test effectiveness, defect prevention, and delivery predictability.
* Partner with Japan technology leaders, product owners, architecture, operations, risk, and vendors to deliver measurable business and engineering outcomes.
* Enable faster change, stronger engineering discipline, improved quality, operational resilience, and transparent delivery economics.



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Product Engineering Leadership for CIS** 



* Provide end\-to\-end technology leadership for Japan CIS, including delivery, engineering discipline, operational stability, security, risk management, and financial outcomes.
* Operate as a product engineering leader, balancing business priorities, platform reliability, technical debt reduction, engineering standards, and delivery accountability.
* Partner with Japan stakeholders to shape roadmaps, define measurable outcomes, and ensure India delivery is aligned to Japan portfolio priorities.
* Drive modern engineering practices such as API enablement, modularization, data modernization, observability, DevSecOps, and engineering governance where relevant to platform evolution.



  





**AI\-First SDLC / ADLC Transformation** 



* Lead adoption of the Agentic Development Lifecycle (ADLC), embedding AI and automation into requirements analysis, design, coding, code review, test generation, defect triage, release readiness, documentation, and production support workflows.
* Actively contribute to ADLC practices by helping define patterns, reusable assets, guardrails, metrics, and adoption playbooks for AI\-assisted engineering.
* Sponsor and/or directly contribute to agentic platform capabilities, including engineering agents, testing agents, quality agents, knowledge agents, and workflow orchestration that support SDLC/ADLC use cases.
* Ensure AI adoption is governed, secure, measurable, and practical for engineers, with clear controls for quality, risk, data handling, and human oversight.
* Measure impact through cycle\-time improvement, automation coverage, defect leakage reduction, quality signals, engineering productivity, reuse, and adoption maturity.



  





**Quality Engineering \& QA Automation Transformation** 



* Own QA and Quality Engineering strategy for Japan technology deliverables, moving from manual, phase\-based testing to automation\-first and AI\-assisted continuous quality engineering.
* Embed automated testing, test data practices, regression optimization, service virtualization, shift\-left quality, and quality gates into Agile and CI/CD delivery models.
* Use AI and intelligent automation for test design, test\-case generation, impact analysis, regression selection, defect prediction, test coverage insights, and quality reporting.
* Establish common QA platforms, metrics, standards, and governance across portfolios while improving speed, stability, and production quality.



  





**Financial, Vendor \& Delivery Governance** 



* Own and manage technology budgets for Japan platforms delivered from MGCC, India, including planning, forecasting, cost transparency, and value realization.
* Govern strategic partners and vendors to align with product engineering, automation\-first delivery, AI\-enabled quality, and measurable outcome commitments.
* Strengthen operating cadence, portfolio transparency, dependency management, risk mitigation, and stakeholder communication across India and Japan teams.



  





**Talent \& Capability Building** 



* Build strong product engineering, quality engineering, automation, AI engineering, and platform capability within the India team.
* Upskill teams toward AI\-first engineering roles, including prompt patterns, agentic workflows, test automation craftsmanship, engineering discipline, and secure use of AI tools.
* Develop leadership depth, succession, and communities of practice across engineering, QA automation, and ADLC adoption.



  





**Knowledge, Skills \& Experience** 



* 15\+ years of technology leadership experience with ownership of large engineering teams, complex platforms, delivery outcomes, financial governance, and senior stakeholder management.
* Strong product engineering mindset with experience improving engineering standards, platform reliability, delivery predictability, and developer experience.
* Demonstrated experience driving AI\-first engineering transformation across SDLC or ADLC practices.
* Hands\-on or sponsorship experience with Agentic AI for engineering, including agentic platforms, SDLC/ADLC agents, automation accelerators, workflow orchestration, and engineering productivity use cases.
* Proven experience leading enterprise\-scale QA / Quality Engineering transformation, including automation strategy, CI/CD integration, test architecture, metrics, and governance.
* Experience with modern engineering practices such as cloud\-aligned modernization, APIs, DevSecOps, observability, data modernization, platform engineering, and engineering controls.
* Strong financial discipline, vendor governance, operational risk awareness, and ability to connect technology investment to business value.
* Experience working with Japan, Asia, or other cross\-border stakeholders is strongly preferred.
* Insurance, policy administration, PAS, agent commission, or financial\-services platform experience is beneficial but optional; it is not a mandatory prerequisite for this role.



  





**Personal Characteristics** 



* AI\-first, engineering\-led transformation leader with a pragmatic delivery mindset.
* Hands\-on enough to shape platforms, patterns, and agentic engineering practices, while senior enough to lead strategy, governance, and stakeholder alignment.
* Balances innovation with controls, security, quality, operational resilience, and financial discipline.
* Collaborative, culturally aware, outcome\-driven, and comfortable working across India and Japan leadership teams.
* Strong people leader who can build confidence, capability, and adoption across engineering and QA teams.

title: Lead Product Manager - Technical
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Lead Product Manager \- Technical
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
   

  

 Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
   

  

**Overview**
 The Mastercard Dispute Lifecycle team in Pune have an exciting opportunity for a Lead Product Management \- Technical to help further enhance and modernize our Dispute management platform.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will quickly develop a deep technical understanding of the applications and systems they support, demonstrating a willingness to dive in, challenge assumptions, and ask thoughtful, probing questions to ensure plans are executed effectively and efficiently.
   

  

 They will bring a strong interest in Payments domain, along with proven technical leadership, and the ability to think creatively applying innovative, out\-of\-the\-box approaches to solve complex problems
   

  

 Role
   

  

* Customer obsession: Champion a deep understanding of customer needs, the broader ecosystem, and key market dynamics, and embed these insights into product decisions
* Systems analysis \& design: Develop an in\-depth understanding of the product platform and its surrounding ecosystem; produce high\-quality functional artifacts for Engineering, including data flows, sequence diagrams, APIs, and interface specifications
* Backlog management: Define and maintain a clear roadmap aligned to business objectives; translate system designs into well\-structured features and user stories that are ready for Engineering execution
* Story elaboration: Lead refinement sessions and create detailed, comprehensive acceptance criteria to ensure clarity and delivery readiness
* Technical analysis: Provide rigorous analysis of application software to validate that business and functional requirements can be effectively delivered
* Strategic alignment: Partner with stakeholders to ensure backlogs are prioritized and refined based on business value, impact, and measurable outcomes
* Agile mindset: Advocate for and model agile best practices across the product lifecycle—from defining epics to writing actionable user stories and acceptance criteria
* Continuous improvement: Measure outcomes, evaluate existing practices and metrics, and drive ongoing optimization across processes, roles, and delivery execution


**All About You**
* Proven product experience: Several years of product management or new product development experience delivering high\-quality products, with the ability to clearly articulate business context and customer use cases
* Technical product expertise: Experience managing highly technical platforms or API\-driven services, with strong software architecture and systems design knowledge
* ISO8583 knowledge (preferred): Familiarity with key payments and dispute management concepts is a plus
* Lean \& Agile delivery: Hands\-on experience with Lean product management and agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban), along with CI/CD and modern DevOps practices
* End\-to\-end ownership: Demonstrated success delivering features from design through development, deployment, and customer integration
* Backlog management: Expertise in grooming epics, features, and user stories; defining clear acceptance and exit criteria; and effectively prioritizing platform backlogs
* Data\-driven decision making: Ability to define and leverage SMART metrics (leading and lagging) to guide product strategy and measure success
* Collaboration \& stakeholder management: Proven ability to work across global, cross\-functional teams, align diverse perspectives, and manage dependencies and co\-development opportunities
* Thrives in ambiguity: Comfortable navigating uncertainty; proactively identifies solutions, engages the right stakeholders, and drives clarity
* Continuous improvement \& communication: Committed to optimizing team processes for speed, quality, and innovation, with excellent written and verbal communication skills


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

The successful candidate will have deep credibility with both engineering teams and senior business stakeholders, a track record of building platforms and the organizational maturity to navigate competing priorities across multiple lines of business.

* Own the full business case and ROI narrative for platform investment, including build\-vs\-buy decisions and multi\-year cost/benefit tradeoffs

 Director Product Management – Technical , AI transformation
   

  

 Director Product Management – Technical – AI Transformation

 The Services Business represents over a third of Mastercard revenues and is a key differentiator for Mastercard.  Within the Services organization, this role sits within the Business \& Markets Insights (BMI) organization.  Role
   

  

* Define and own the AI product strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities for Payment Performance Intelligence.

title: Solution Analyst - Supply Chain Planning
description:
**Job Summary**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 Vertiv is transforming and digitizing supply chain capabilities by re\-engineering business processes and implementing advanced technologies/systems that powers world‑class operations, customer experiences, and AI‑driven decision\-making.
   

  

 We are seeking a
 **Senior Solution Analyst – Supply Chain Planning** 
 for our Digital Supply Solutions group. This leader acts as a Product manager and is responsible for end\-to\-end planning systems capabilities from strategy, business stakeholder management, portfolio prioritization and delivery/maintenance of planning capabilities to support Vertiv’s business units. The position provides subject matter expertise in various domains of supply chain planning (demand, supply, manufacturing etc.) a hands\-on systems knowledge and experience/exposure to AI in supply chain opportunities.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Responsible for implementation of Advanced Planning capabilities and owns specific domain area : Demand/S\&OP or Supply/Inventory/Manufacturing Planning or Spares Parts Planning solutions
* Design robust touch\-less digital planning solutions for scale, availability and growth
* Owns and drives deliverables through SDLC
* Manges portfolio of digital supply chain programs in the specific domain area of ownership
* Works across teams and external partners to drive major transformation program in specific domain area
* Scope, plan, and manage projects, quality of software development, risks, schedules, communication plans, and deliverables.
* Responsible for building a global template of domain specific capabilities and rollouts across 33\+ and growing plants around the world
* Build supply chain planning capabilities as a Product
* Serves as primary IT contact to business stakeholders for domain specific ownership (Demand/S\&OP/Supply/Mfg/Spares)
* Brings a DevOps mindset and helps expand it into a CoE
* Responsible for standardizing the planning global template and baselining with industry and tool standards
* Owns and manages relevant KPIs
* Revolutionize end\-to\-end supply chain models
* Serve as a senior technical mentor to data engineers, solution architects, and product teams
* Introduce best practices, emerging patterns, and modern architectural approaches
* Influence stakeholders across business and technology with strong communication, storytelling, and technical depth


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Math, Statistics, or related field. MBA or master’s preferred but not required.
* 4\+ years of progressive experience in implementing complex supply chain solutions, strong knowledge of operational processes, systems, and tools implementation experience in leading/fast growth companies
* Deep domain expertise in supply chain planning across two or more areas : demand forecasting, S\&OP, multi\-level integrated supply planning, distribution, inventory optimization, manufacturing planning and scheduling, ATP/CTP
* Multiple E2E implementations of advanced planning technologies implementing Kinaxis Rapidresponse/Maestro
* Extensive, hands\-on experience in supply chain complex solution design including authoring, data integrations, scenario planning and best practices
* Proven experience translating business processes into scalable digital solutions
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end supply chain processes and supply chain strategies (ETO/CTO, MEIO, VMI etc)
* Preferred
+ Kinaxis Maestro authoring and solution consultant certifications
+ Experience enabling AI/ML for supply chain use cases
+ Prior experience with global manufacturing environments

 Work Authorization
   

  

 No calls or agencies please. Vertiv will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. title: Electronic Systems Technical Specialist - Tools
description:
**Job Summary**
 The System Requirements Engineer is responsible for translating business and stakeholder needs into clear, complete, and verifiable technical requirements for electronic tools and embedded software systems. The role involves defining functional and non\-functional requirements, documenting system interfaces and boundaries, identifying failure cases, supporting FMEA activities, and leading structured problem\-solving with cross\-functional stakeholders.
   

  

 The position works closely with product, software development, testing, supplier, and customer teams to ensure requirements are well understood, traceable, and aligned with product and business needs. The role also contributes to the development, verification, and continuous improvement of electronic tools and associated engineering processes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Understand business, customer, and stakeholder needs and translate them into clear functional and non\-functional technical requirements .
* Create, document, review, and maintain System Requirement Specifications (SRS) and Functional Requirement Specifications (FRS) .
* Analyze component and supplier interfaces, including libraries, to identify gaps, dependencies, and requirements for changing product needs.
* Define system boundaries, interfaces, dependencies, and interactions through boundary diagrams, flow charts, and system\-level documentation .
* Identify potential failure cases during requirements development and support the preparation and review of FMEA documents.
* Establish acceptance criteria and ensure requirements are complete, consistent, testable, and traceable throughout the product lifecycle.
* Lead structured problem\-solving activities with customers, development, testing, and other key stakeholders to resolve technical issues and close knowledge gaps.
* Investigate electronic tools and software\-related problems, identify causal mechanisms, recommend solutions, and document problem resolution.
* Collaborate with product and software development teams to support the delivery and verification of software features, components, builds, and engineering tools.
* Support requirements, design, development, testing, and release activities for electronic tools used in the development, service, and manufacturing of Cummins products.
* Participate in system architecture, requirements, design, and verification discussions and provide technical recommendations.
* Assess the impact of requirement changes on project scope, schedule, resources, and related system components.
* Support product verification and validation by ensuring requirements are linked to appropriate test cases and acceptance criteria.
* Contribute to the improvement of requirements engineering processes, tools, and work practices.
* Work effectively with global cross\-functional teams and take ownership of assigned deliverables to ensure timely completion.
* Support knowledge sharing and provide guidance to less\-experienced engineers and team members as required.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Electronics, Automotive Engineering, or another relevant STEM discipline.
* Master's degree in a relevant technical discipline is preferred for select roles.
* Relevant certifications or training in systems engineering, requirements engineering, Agile/SCRUM, or FMEA would be an advantage.


**Skills \& Experience**
* Prior experience in system requirements engineering, systems engineering, embedded software, electronic tools, or a related technical discipline .
* Strong ability to translate business and customer requirements into detailed technical requirements.
* Experience creating and maintaining SRS/FRS and requirements documentation .
* Experience with requirements management tools such as Integrity ; knowledge of DOORS is an advantage.
* Experience creating flow charts, system context diagrams, and boundary diagrams using Visio, Microsoft Word, or similar tools.
* Good understanding of system interfaces, dependencies, functional decomposition, and requirements traceability.
* Experience identifying failure cases during requirements development and exposure to FMEA methodologies.
* Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving skills.
* Good understanding of software/product development, testing, verification, and validation processes.
* Knowledge of SCRUM/Agile methodology is an advantage.
* Experience documenting requirements for mobile platforms such as Android or iOS is preferred.
* Automotive domain experience, particularly in embedded systems or electronic products, is preferred.
* Knowledge of PC/mobile software platforms, embedded systems, software lifecycle tools, and configuration/change management is beneficial.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical information to diverse stakeholders.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and ability to work independently in a fast\-paced and demanding environment.
* Good team\-player skills with a willingness to learn new applications, products, and technologies.
* Ability to manage complexity, make sound technical decisions, and deliver quality results within committed timelines.


 Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools is preferred.
