title: Enterprise Product Manager
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI\-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high\-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
   

  

**About Snowflake**
 Founded by industry experts and backed by strategic investors, our disruptive built\-for\-the\-cloud architecture was designed to push the limitations of conventional data warehousing. Our teams breed ambition, challenge ordinary thinking, push the pace of innovation, and work hard to provide our customers with the best experience possible.
   

  

 As an Enterprise Product Manager, your key role will be to optimize and strategically evolve Workday Finance Order to Cash (OTC) IT Systems at Snowflake. You will bridge diverse business stakeholders and skilled development teams, translating complex business requirements into precise, actionable functional specifications for technical implementations.
   

  

 This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the entire solution lifecycle for critical OTC systems, from design to deployment. Your expertise will directly impact the efficiency, scalability, and accuracy of Snowflake's revenue\-generating processes, ensuring a robust OTC ecosystem.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
 As an Enterprise Product Manager, you will independently contribute to and lead the following areas:
   

  

* Process Optimization: Optimize and strategically evolve Workday Finance Order to Cash (OTC) systems, bridging business needs with technical solutions.
* Operational Excellence: Independently contribute to Customer Contracts, Billing, Collections, Invoices, and Settlements, as well as OTC period close activities.
* Transformation Projects: Lead and participate in Order Management and Billing transformation projects and large\-scale operational changes.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with other business application owners to ensure smooth business automation and data management processes across the ecosystem.
* Roadmap \& Strategy: Provide expert input into the IT Roadmap, including Workday new feature rollouts, major releases, and the implementation of new modules.
* Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) and champion in driving industry best practices for the evolution of Snowflake’s OTC business users.
* Agile Leadership: Organize various scrum ceremonies (daily standups, sprint planning, retrospectives) using agile methodology.
* Quality \& Training: Lead quality assurance by defining testing strategies, identifying risks, and assisting in the creation of training materials and release notes for OTC users.


**Key Duties include:**
* Gathering and translating complex business requirements from diverse stakeholders into actionable functional specifications.
* Working with cross\-functional teams to develop comprehensive design and solution documents.
* Managing communications and change processes for all new changes on the platform.
* Developing and executing test scripts for UAT, post\-sprint, and regression testing.
* Ensuring system issues are identified, tracked, and resolved in a timely manner.


**What We Need To See**
* Education: A Bachelor’s degree or higher, preferably with an emphasis in Information Systems or Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
* Experience: Minimum 8\+ years of direct experience working on Order to Cash (OTC) implementations or operations as a Business Systems Analyst or Product Manager.
* Technical Expertise: Expert knowledge of Workday systems or similar ERPs (Oracle Apps, Peoplesoft, SAP) specifically in OTC modules like Quoting, Revenue, Billing, and Collections.
+ Experience integrating custom or 3rd\-party applications with Workday or other ERPs.
+ Basic understanding and working knowledge of Databases, including writing SQL queries.

* Functional Knowledge: Superior understanding of OTC concepts and principles, including Quoting processes, Billings, Cash Applications, and New Product Introductions (NPI).
* Skills: Highly developed written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
+ Strong attention to detail, goal\-oriented mindset, and the ability to adapt to changing requirements.
+ Expert leadership and collaboration skills with the ability to build relationships with stakeholders ranging from executive to line level.
+ Commitment to excellent customer service and a strong focus on quality.

* Ability: Proven ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team environment.


 Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.
   

  

 How do you want to make your impact?

description:
**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
 We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
   

  

**Job Title**
 Advisor, Product Delivery
   

  

**What does a successful Product Owner do at Fiserv?**
 The Product Owner (PO) s responsible for maximizing the value delivered by the team and ensuring that the Team Backlog is aligned with customer and stakeholder needs. The PO is the team’s primary customer advocate and primary link to business and technology strategy. This enables the team to balance the needs of multiple stakeholders while continuously evolving the Solution.
   

  

 The PO represents the needs of customers and the business within a particular Solution domain, which is typically co\-represented by a Product Manager. Together, they ensure that product strategy and implementation remain connected throughout the value stream. Serving as the ‘voice of the customer’ for the team entails a broad range of responsibilities. The PO must build and manage key relationships, synthesize information from multiple sources, maintain business alignment in the Team Backlog, and communicate effectively with a variety of audiences—all with a bias toward delivering, and learning, quickly.
   

  

 The PO is ultimately responsible for maximizing the value delivered by the Agile team, which requires the PO to ensure that the right solutions are built and that they are built the right way. However, the PO cannot accomplish this alone. Building the right solutions requires deep knowledge of business strategy, customer segments, market dynamics, and value stream economics. The PO establishes a close relationship with Product Management to derive these macro\-level insights and apply them to specific product domains. Building solutions the right way requires Team and Technical Agility, DevOps practices, and a Continuous Delivery Pipeline. These technical capabilities determine the speed and quality with which value can be delivered, and the PO relies on the Agile team to provide them. The PO provides a crucial link in the bi\-directional information flow between Product Management and the Agile team. As shown in Figure 2, the PO keeps the Agile team informed of the strategy that drives product design and keeps Product Management informed of the innovations that influence the evolution of product strategy. Customer feedback aligns thinking from strategy through execution and is accessible to all roles.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* The PO, in close partnership with Product Management, applies a customer\-centric mindset along with design thinking tools to guide the team toward delivering solutions that are desirable, viable, feasible, and sustainable.
* The PO must understand what solutions and experiences the teams can deliver. This practical insight is a valuable contribution to the vision and roadmaps that guide solution implementation.
* In collaboration with Product Management, System Architects, Delivery Management and other stakeholders, POs help guide the sequencing of features over time toward the best economic outcomes. Through their understanding of which problems need to be solved, which solutions would best solve them, and the feasibility of delivering those solutions, POs help ensure that the vision and roadmap are reflected in the Jira Project Backlog.
* The PO should communicate the vision and roadmap during PI Planning to ensure teams are aligned and ready to execute against them.
* It is the PO’s responsibility to ensure that they are well\-formed and aligned with product strategy. The PO clarifies story details, applies user\-story voice, ensures ‘INVEST’ characteristics are present, assists with story splitting, defines enablers, and incorporates behavior\-driven design (BDD) to ensure stories support continuous value flow. The PO also allows space for ‘local’ stories and spikes that advance product design but are not derived explicitly from the strategic roadmap.
* Achieving continuous value flow requires that the highest\-value backlog items are delivered in the shortest sustainable lead time and in the right sequence. The PO enables this by regularly ordering backlog items according to their cost of delay and communicating that sequence to the team during backlog refinement
* The PO works with the team to agree on accepted story completion. This includes validating that the story meets acceptance criteria, that it has the appropriate, persistent acceptance tests, and that it otherwise complies with its Definition of Done (DoD). In so doing, the PO assures that quality is built in.
* POs facilitate frequent conversations with their teams to resolve questions, manage dependencies, and communicate priorities that emerge as stories are implemented. This information also helps the team slice stories effectively to achieve increased velocity and shortened learning cycles.
* The PO regularly evaluates progress toward story acceptance criteria, including compliance with Built\-In\-Quality criteria, such as the scalable definition of done, and non\-functional requirements (NFRs). The PO works closely with the team to detect quality issues as they are introduced and correct them in or near real time.
* As a member of the Agile team, the PO attends and actively participates in team events during PI execution. During iteration planning, backlog refinement, iteration reviews, team retrospectives, and team syncs, the PO provides crucial feedback on the team’s work from an outside\-in, customer\-centric point of view. By participating in PO Sync and System Demos, the PO helps the team satisfy dependencies, demonstrate incremental value, and maintain cadence with the roadmap.
* The PO collects and shares feedback with Product Management and System Architects as part of Continuous Exploration, with their teams during backlog refinement, iteration planning, and iteration reviews, system demos, and, if applicable, Inspect and Adapt events.

Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. We cultivate a culture of inclusion (https://www.mastercard.us/en\-us/vision/who\-we\-are/diversity\-inclusion.html) for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation, and delivers better business results.
   

  

 Job Title
   

  

 Global Product Manager, Virtual Card Platform
   

  

**Overview**
 Global Business\-to\-Business (B2B) payment flows represent a $125T opportunity. Most of it happens on non\-card rails, representing tremendous growth opportunity for Mastercard’s Commercial Cards business. Accelerating the adoption of Commercial Payments is a strategic imperative for Mastercard and this role is critical to our team meeting our growth aspirations.
   

  

 The In Control platform for Commercial Payments (ICCP) and In Control for Business Travel (ICBT) are part of the Commercial Platform family that is responsible for delivering safe, smart, and simple payment solutions to middle and large market segment supporting both travel (T\&E) and B2B payments. The In Control platform (https://www.mastercard.com/incontroldemo/en/home.html) is a key to driving core brand and services revenue for the middle and large market commercial segments, supporting both T\&E and B2B payments.
   

  

 The Mastercard Product Management team leads the launch and delivery of the platform. As a member of this team, you will have the chance to shape and influence the platform using your customer insights and product development capabilities. As a Product Manager, you will become a Subject Matter Expert (SME) on the In Control platform and work closely with engineering team and regional account teams to deliver world class B2B payment products to Mastercard customers.
   

  

 In addition, this role is heavily involved in defining the overall Platform vision, including enhancement support, testing and release support.

 Background preferred in one or more of the following:
   

  

* Product management and development
* Agile development
* Customer engagement / Business development
* Go\-to\-market planning and execution
* Technology Development \& Operations
* Commercial payments

* Strong analytical skills with ability to drive deep product insights from data
* Ability to take independent action and be comfortable interacting with varying levels of leadership across the organization, both internal and external

* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

**Company Description**
 Entain India is the engineering and delivery powerhouse for Entain, one of the world's leading global sports and gaming groups. Established in Hyderabad in 2001, we've grown from a small tech hub into a dynamic force, delivering cutting\-edge software solutions and support services that power billions of transactions for millions of users worldwide.
   

  

 Our focus on quality at scale drives us to create innovative technology that supports Entain's mission to lead the change in global sports and gaming sector. At Entain India, we make the impossible possible, togethe
   

  

**Job Description**
 As a Product Manager, you'll bring your product expertise into a new way of working. You won't just write specs and manage roadmaps — you'll define missions, validate outcomes with data, and use AI to accelerate discovery, analysis, and delivery. You'll work in a small, mission\-driven cross\-functional team called a pod — three functions (Product, Engineer, Quality) with high agency, shared ownership, and no hand\-offs.
   

  

 Reporting to the Product Leader, you'll join the Product \& Technology Team. Are you ready to be part of a team that's redefining how products get built in an AI Native setup?
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Define and own the pod's mission — the business outcome, the target customer, the success metrics.
* Validate ideas with data and customer insight before committing the pod to build.
* Use AI agents for discovery, competitive analysis, spec writing, and backlog health.
* Write specs that both humans and AI can parse — clear acceptance criteria, clear "why".
* Operate in continuous flow (Kanban) — prioritise ruthlessly, respect WIP limits, ship daily.
* Map dependencies and integration points across teams. Unblock the pod before it gets blocked.
* Get your hands dirty — prototype, script, or contribute code with AI assistance when it moves the mission faster.
* Understand the engineering decisions behind the product — architecture trade\-offs, system constraints, deployment impact.
* Track mission KPIs in production and use outcomes to steer what comes next.
* Collaborate across pods, stakeholders, and commercial partners spanning multiple geographies.


**Qualifications**
 Engineering Mindset — What We Look For
   

  

**We Assess Every Candidate Across Six Core Dimensions**
* AI Fluency — AI is the primary way we engineer. You prompt, evaluate, iterate. Manual coding is a deliberate choice, not the default.
* Cross\-Functional Versatility — "That's not my area" doesn't exist. You contribute beyond your discipline, share openly, and communicate clearly across formats.
* Customer and Value Awareness — Ask "why" and "for whom" before "how". Zoom out to see the business, zoom in to trace the bug. Map dependencies before you build.
* Craft — Pride in the quality of what you create — specs, prototypes, or code with AI assistance. Clear structure, attention to detail, and a bar that applies to every artefact you ship.
* Technical Curiosity — Build a prototype and break it before reading the docs. Stay curious about how things work.
* Agency \& Entrepreneurship — Don't wait for permission. Own outcomes end\-to\-end, make others successful, challenge the status quo.


**Must Have**
* Experienced Product Manager with a track record of delivering excellent digital experiences.
* Strong product strategy, discovery, and prioritisation skills — RICE, impact mapping, or equivalent.
* Ability to write clear specs and acceptance criteria that engineering and AI agents can act on.
* Data\-driven decision making — comfortable with KPIs, A/B testing, analytics, and customer research.
* Proficiency with AI\-assisted workflows — using AI for discovery, competitive analysis, spec writing, and validation.
* Experience managing dependencies and stakeholders across international, cross\-functional teams.
* Excellent communication skills — written, verbal, and presentation — with the ability to adjust for audience.
* Experience with Jira, Confluence, and product lifecycle tooling.
* Ability to mentor other Product Managers — onboarding new PMs and supporting the growth of peers through coaching and knowledge\-sharing.


**Nice to Have**
* Ability to write or modify code with AI assistance — prototyping, scripting, or contributing small changes directly.
* Engineering degree or technical background — able to engage confidently in architecture and system design discussions.
* Experience with agent systems, AI evaluation, or building AI\-augmented product workflows.
* Background in industries with strict regulatory requirements (gaming, financial services, healthcare).
* Experience creating wireframes, prototypes, or working directly with design systems.

 At Entain India, we offer a strong package and the support people need to make an impact. Join us, and a great compensation package is just the beginning. You can expect to receive benefits like:

description:
**About Sibros Technologies**
****Who We Are****
 Sibros is accelerating the future of SDV excellence with its Deep Connected Platform™ that orchestrates full vehicle software update management, vehicle analytics, and remote commands in one integrated system. Adaptable to any vehicle architecture, Sibros’ platform meets stringent safety, security, and compliance standards, propelling OEMs to innovate new connected vehicle use cases across fleet management, predictive maintenance, data monetization, and beyond.
   

  

 Learn more at www.sibros.tech.
   

  

****Our Mission****
 Our mission is to help our customers get the most value out of their connected devices.
   

  

 Follow us on
   

  

 LinkedIn \| Youtube \| Instagram
   

  

**About The Role**
****Job Title:****
 Product Manager \- Core Platform \& Infrastructure
   

  

****Reporting to:****
 Group Product Manager
   

  

****Job Type:****
 Full\-Time
   

  

****Experience:****
 5\+ years
   

  

 As a Product Manager for Core Infrastructure at Sibros, you aren't just managing a backlog \- you are the architect of the foundational pipeline that connects vehicles to the cloud. You will sit at the intersection of embedded automotive systems, distributed cloud computing, and business strategy. We are looking for a highly technical product leader who can navigate the complex, high\-stakes landscape of modern vehicle architectures. You will own the core platforms that orchestrate flawless over\-the\-air (OTA) updates, secure remote diagnostics, and resilient vehicle\-to\-cloud data ingestion, transforming complex technical constraints into a highly reliable, scalable enterprise platform.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

* Own the Core Vehicle\-to\-Cloud Pipeline: Lead the full product lifecycle for our foundational infrastructure products, including OTA orchestration engines and remote command delivery. You will ensure this core platform acts as a rock\-solid, extensible foundation that reliably powers all downstream applications built on top of it, such as advanced troubleshooting, predictive maintenance, and fleet management tools.
* Optimize Value Delivery: Ruthlessly prioritize the platform backlog. You’ll make the hard trade\-off decisions between technical debt, architectural scalability, security compliance, and OEM feature requests to maximize platform ROI.
* Define System Boundaries and APIs: Partner closely with Embedded, Cloud, and Security Engineering to define robust APIs, data contracts, and platform abstractions that allow Sibros to integrate seamlessly into diverse OEM vehicle architectures.
* Drive Platform Reliability \& Scale: Define and track critical platform KPIs (e.g. OTA success rates, command latency, system uptime) and use technical discovery to address architectural bottlenecks proactively.
* Autonomous Decision\-Making: Act as the primary authority for your platform infrastructure domain, synthesizing deeply technical constraints and market requirements into a clear, prioritized roadmap without requiring day\-to\-day tactical guidance.
* Cross\-Functional Technical Leadership: Interface with Business Development, Solutions Architecture, and Engineering to translate complex OEM infrastructure requirements into scalable, platform\-agnostic solutions that serve diverse vehicle segments.


 What you should know
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* Professional Experience: 5\+ years of Product Management experience in high\-growth environments, with a proven track record of delivering deeply technical platform products, infrastructure, or middleware at scale.
* Automotive \& Mobility Domain Expertise: Strong understanding of the vehicle architecture ecosystem, including telemetry, automotive communication protocols (CAN, Ethernet), and diagnostic standards (UDS, SOVD).
* Systems Thinking \& Scale: Experience managing backend or platform products that bridge embedded edge environments and distributed cloud infrastructure. You design with the entire ecosystem in mind, ensuring that changes to the core platform account for, support, and align with upstream OEM workflows, downstream applications, and broader data dependencies.
* Strategic Autonomy: You are a principled, self\-directed leader with a history of making high\-stakes technical decisions independently. You excel at navigating ambiguity and establishing clear technical directions in a fast\-paced environment.
* Technical Communication: Exceptional ability to translate complex architectural constraints and infrastructure concepts into strategic business value for executive stakeholders and OEM partners.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Automotive Cybersecurity \& Safety Standards: Familiarity with functional safety (ISO 26262\), automotive cybersecurity (ISO 21434\).
* Engineering Roots: A background in Embedded Software, Cloud Systems Architecture, or Systems Engineering is highly desirable.
* Enterprise Integration: Experience building developer\-facing tools, SDKs, or highly flexible APIs used by third\-party enterprise engineering groups.


 What We Offer
   

  

* Competitive compensation package with performance incentives.
* A dynamic work environment with a flat hierarchy and the opportunity for rapid career advancement.
* Access to continuous learning and development opportunities.
* Flexible working hours to accommodate different time zones.
* Comprehensive benefits package including health insurance and wellness programs.
* A culture that values innovation and promotes a work\-life balance.


****Equal Opportunity Employer****
 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.
   

  

**This job description provides a comprehensive outline designed to attract highly technical product managers looking to advance their careers in the dynamic and growing software\-defined vehicle industry. Adjustments can be made based on the specific needs of your team and changes in business strategies.**

 As a
 **Cyber Forward Deployed Engineering Manager** 
 , you will operate at the intersection of client delivery, engineering execution, and solution shaping. You will lead cross\-functional teams to design, build, and deploy high\-quality cybersecurity and AI\-enabled solutions in client environments. This role requires strong technical depth, delivery ownership, and the ability to translate ambiguous business and cybersecurity needs into scalable, production\-ready solutions.
   

  

 You will be expected to manage workstreams end\-to\-end, guide architecture and engineering decisions, mentor engineers, and engage directly with client stakeholders to drive outcomes. You will also play a key role in pursuits, prototypes, and product feedback loops that shape reusable capabilities across Deloitte’s Cyber Engineering offerings.

**Client Leadership \& Delivery Ownership**

* Experience working directly with senior business and technical stakeholders to translate requirements into architecture, roadmaps, and delivered solutions.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts, risks, dependencies, and trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated experience leading engineers, reviewing designs and code, and driving accountability across delivery teams.
* Strong ownership mindset with a focus on client outcomes, delivery rigor, and continuous improvement.


**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
* Familiarity with cybersecurity domains such as application security, cloud security, identity, SOC engineering, detection engineering, or cyber analytics.
* Experience in product engineering or platform engineering environments.
* Experience with DevSecOps practices and secure software development lifecycle.
* Exposure to search and analytics platforms such as Elasticsearch/OpenSearch and graph databases such as Neo4j.
* Experience with Kubernetes, GitOps, infrastructure as code, and advanced cloud\-native engineering patterns.
* Cloud certifications across AWS, Azure, or GCP.

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.

**Overview**
 The Services team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing cutting\-edge products and services that help our customers. Focused on thinking big and scaling quickly around the globe, this agile team is responsible for end\-to\-end solutions for a diverse global customer base including issuers, acquirers, and merchants. Centered on data\-driven technologies and innovation, these services include payments\-focused consulting, loyalty and marketing programs, business experimentation (Test \& Learn), and data\-driven information and risk management services.
   

  

 As a member of the Business Experimentation Product Management team, you will build industry\-leading experimentation software which brings sophisticated analytic techniques to businesses and users around the world. We are looking for AI native PMs who can execute and evolve our product strategy and help us build the AI enhanced version of Test \& Learn.
   

  

 Role
   

  

 Product Manager for Mastercard’s Test \& Learn product, an analytic platform used by the world's largest organizations to make multi\-million\-dollar decisions.

 Unlock the power of AI. Define how and where AI technology enhances the measurement and optimization of business initiatives.
   

  

**All About You**
 Can work closely with cross\-functional partners like engineers, designers, sales, marketing, and users.
   

  

 A quick learner with the ability to multi\-task in a team environment, not afraid to ask questions and make decisions. Enthusiastic, effective team member and mentor.
   

  

 Broad strategic thinking skills, adept in translating product vision/strategy into an actionable roadmap.
   

  

 Creative problem\-solver, can balance competing needs and prioritize thoughtfully.
   

  

 Strong professional presence. Excellent interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills.
   

  

 Experience building with AI or using AI to enhance an existing software application
   

  

 5\+ years of professional experience in a similar role, or equivalent.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**About Druva**
 Druva is the resilience foundation for the AI enterprise, helping organizations secure and recover from connected risk across data, cyber, identity, and AI. The Resilience Cloud is a fully managed, cloud\-native SaaS platform that delivers air\-gapped and immutable protection across cloud, SaaS, on\-premises, endpoint, and edge environments. Powered by Dru MetaGraph, Druva’s graph\-powered intelligence layer, the platform connects critical business context so customers can understand risk, respond faster, recover cleanly, and govern data with greater confidence.
   

  

 Trusted by nearly 7,500 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 500, Druva helps safeguard the critical information and systems businesses depend on in an increasingly connected world.
   

  

 Visit druva.com and follow us on LinkedIn, X and Facebook.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The SaaS Apps product line is a significant revenue generator for Druva with massive expansion and growth plans in the near term. With the explosion in AI and the implications for data protection, data governance, identity and security, many key Druva initiatives are being driven out of the SaaS Apps team. This is a key role with major scope and will provide opportunity for immediate impact and company\-wide visibility. The candidate will gain valuable experience in a hyper\-growth startup and develop key career skills on driving a growing product to product\-market fit and SaaS go\-to\-market.
   

  

**Role Purpose \& Impact**
 This is a field and customer\-facing product management role which acts as a strategic partner to senior leadership, influencing product direction and aligning the SaaS roadmap with company objectives. You will collaborate with our cross\-functional customer\-facing teams to interact with our growing customer base to understand their data protection, security and governance needs and bring back insights and ideas for Druva’s roadmap.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Explore new product features, concepts and develop comprehensive market/product requirements across SaaS applications
* Sales, Customer interaction for product demos, roadmap presentations, product feedback and escalations
* Analyze business metrics to develop insights for product go\-to\-market activities and execute on them in collaboration with product marketing, sales
* Work with product managers and product marketing team to build key product marketing collateral and deliver field sales team training
* Analyze product telemetry to develop insights for product roadmap and drive product adoption
* Respond to industry analyst questionnaires, surveys and develop analyst facing presentations


**What Makes You a Great Fit**
* 8\+ years of total professional experience building and shipping B2B SaaS products, with at least 5 years of functional product management experience.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, MBA would be a plus
* Experience working in the data protection domain, particularly in the Microsoft ecosystem (M365, Copilot, D365, Intune)
* Experience with other major SaaS platforms (Google, Salesforce, ServiceNow) a major plus
* Experience with Identity infrastructure (Entra ID, Okta, Active Directory) a major plus


**Highly technical background with an ability to dive deep into products, technology, UX**
* Excellent product sense with an ability/empathy to deeply focus on customer pain points, workflows and an ability to articulate the same
* Highly analytical with an ability to understand metrics, develop a data driven point\-of\-view


**Excellent PM Presence With Clear Written, Verbal Communication Skills**
* Track record of iterating, taking ownership and driving products from concept to execution
* Experience working in high growth, startup environments, with a can\-do attitude


**What Success Looks Like In The Role**
* Ensure customer success through strategic leadership, operational excellence, and collaboration with cross\-functional teams
* Establish strong relationships with customers and partners in order to drive outside\-in thinking across the organization
* Identify new business opportunities based on deep understanding of customer needs, competitive offerings, and Druva’s unique value proposition
* Drive planning and execution of new high\-profile products to support revenue growth.
* Enable the sales and technical sales teams so that they can successfully sell products and deliver maximum ROI for customers
* Mentor and guide junior product managers, fostering a culture of best\-practice sharing.
* Lead the discovery and definition of long\-term product strategy, translating market trends and deep customer insights into actionable, multi\-quarter roadmaps.


**Why You’ll Love Working Here**
 Innovation is how we operate, not a side project. You’ll work in a culture that values bold thinking and continuous improvement, where global teams experiment, iterate, and turn new ideas into products customers can rely on.
   

  

 If you’re looking for high\-ownership work, visible impact, and a culture that values innovation, collaboration, accountability, and growth—where you’ll be trusted to lead and empowered to build—you’ll thrive at Druva.

title: Product Owner
description:
**About Tripstack**
 Founded in Toronto, Canada in 2016, Tripstack has been part of Etraveli Group since 2019\. It is a B2B Flights as a Service provider and a world leader in virtual interlining.
   

  

 Operating from offices in Canada, India, and Poland, Tripstack is the gateway into Etraveli Group’s world leading tech platform \- giving partners access to global flight content, virtual interlining, and a full suite of services including payments, fraud prevention, pricing, and customer support. As a world leader in virtual interlining technology, Tripstack connects non\-partner, low\-cost and full\-service carriers, enabling the creation of unique and flexible itineraries through a simple, cost\-effective API.
   

  

 Its technology ingest over 30B price points and handles over 240 million searches daily.
   

  

 Through partnerships with airlines, OTAs, and other distribution channels across the globe, Tripstack expands networks, drives new revenue streams, and offers more choice at competitive prices, all backed by robust technology and traveler protection.
   

  

 For more information, visit:
   

  

 www.tripstack.com
   

  

 www.etraveligroup.com
   

  

 The role
   

  

 As a Product Owner at Tripstack, you'll report into a Product Manager serving as an operational leader and product strategist for your portfolio within the Content Acquisition team.
   

  

 You will oversee the integration and operation of flight content into our platform, ensuring we maintain world\-leading content at the highest possible quality while keeping our systems stable and performant.
   

  

 Job Responsibilities
   

  

**Operational Leadership \& Incident Management**
* Own end\-to\-end operational performance of your assigned content portfolio (APIs, consolidators, or scrapes), ensuring system stability, SLA adherence, and production health
* Lead incident management and structured RCA (root cause analysis) investigations for any issues; drive resolution tracking and prevention of recurring production issues
* Define, monitor, and proactively manage operational KPIs: uptime, latency, booking failures, error rates, conversion impact, and portfolio risks
* Act as primary operational escalation point for airline\-related issues, coordinating rapidly across engineering, product teams, and external airline partners


**Cross\-Functional Coordination \& Priority Management**
* Facilitate resource planning and allocation decisions with your engineering team; identify constraints and trade\-offs
* Manage the balance between competing priorities (new feature development, production support, incident response, and ad\-hoc requests)
* Define and communicate clear priorities to engineering teams \- including what gets deprioritized and why
* Coordinate all team standups, sprint planning, ROMs (Rough Order of Magnitude reviews), and alignment meetings
* Track dependencies, blockers, and risks; escalate appropriately and coordinate cross\-team resolution
* Monitor sprint velocity, deliverables, and team output; continuously optimize processes for delivery efficiency


**Stakeholder Alignment \& Communication**
* Align internal stakeholders (engineering, product leadership, data teams) and external partners (Etraveli Group, airlines, consolidators) around priorities, timelines, and expectations
* Communicate operational status, KPIs, and business decisions clearly and concisely \- orally and in writing
* Facilitate regular sync meetings with engineering leadership, other product teams, and stakeholders
* Prepare status reports, milestone updates, and analytics dashboards for leadership visibility


**Product Definition \& Requirements**
* Translate high\-level business objectives and customer needs into clear, well\-documented product requirements and user stories
* Define acceptance criteria and work with QA to establish test cases
* Establish acceptance criteria and work with QA teams to build comprehensive test cases
* Create reusable components and standardized approaches across recipe integrations to improve quality and reduce duplicative work


**Strategic Analysis \& Decision\-Making**
* Conduct data\-backed analysis to inform prioritization decisions; evaluate impact against business value
* Work with architects, engineering managers, and product leaders to assess technical feasibility and design efficient solutions
* Identify opportunities for improvement in security, CI/CD, quality, and performance practices
* Monitor KPIs tied to product decisions and iterate based on results
* Root cause analysis of systemic product issues and recommend structural improvements


**Partnership with Engineering \& Architecture**
* Collaborate with engineering leads on solution architecture, ensuring alignment between product vision and technical implementation
* Work with platform and engineering teams to identify and resolve technical blockers
* Support architecture decisions that balance speed of delivery with long\-term platform health


 Job Requirements
   

  

* 3\+ years hands\-on experience in a product or program management role with significant operational responsibility
* Strong project management and organizational skills with ability to juggle multiple competing priorities
* Excellent communication skills across technical teams, product teams, and non\-technical stakeholders
* Strategic thinker with strong experience in data\-backed decision making
* Comfort with ambiguity; ability to move fast and make decisions with incomplete information
* Leadership skills: ability to bring teams together toward a common purpose and coordinate across multiple teams


**Technical \& Industry Knowledge**
* Knowledge of software architecture, REST, cloud platforms, platform engineering, and microservices
* Experience working as a hands\-on QA engineer or application developer would be advantageous
* Travel industry experience \- particularly with airline APIs, NDC standards, or GDS/PSS systems
* Experience building airline or flight content integrations
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, monitoring tools, and production observability platforms


**Personal Attributes**
* Output and delivery driven; results\-oriented mindset
* Resilient with ability to thrive under pressure and competing demands
* Proficient in communication: clear, concise, and professional across contexts
* Passion for problem\-solving, root cause analysis, and operational excellence
* Highly accountable team player; takes ownership of outcomes


**Benefits**
 We offer an opportunity to work with a young, dynamic, and a growing team composed of high\-caliber professionals. We value professionalism and promote a culture where individuals are encouraged to do more and be more. If you feel you share our passion for excellence, and growth, then look no further. We have an ambitious mission, and we need a world\-class team to make it a reality. Upgrade to a First Class team!
   

  

 At Tripstack, we proudly believe in embracing diversity. This is true for our team, clients, communities and stakeholders. We are an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating a safe, healthy and accessible environment. We encourage applications regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or any other grounds protected by law. Please let us know if you need any accommodations during any part of the recruitment process.
   

  

 Tripstack thanks all applicants for their interest, however only those selected to continue in the process will be contacted.
   

  

 Learn more about us at www.tripstack.com

title: EH-FY27-Consulting-S&T-Strategy-Senior Consultant-TS-AI Strategy
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Strategy \& Transactions \- SFL Scientific– AI Strategy ( Senior Consultant)**
 At Deloitte Strategy \& Transactions (S\&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth. SFL Scientific is part of Deloitte’s AI strategy, data science, and engineering practice. We help clients move beyond pilots by shaping enterprise AI ambition, prioritizing high\-value use cases, designing AI operating models and governance, and partnering with technical teams to scale AI solutions that deliver measurable business value.
   

  

 We serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data\-driven choices, using the state\-of\-the\-art technologies, to advise our clients on how to leverage AI technologies and working directly with them to design , implement and scale novel solutions that drive value.
   

  

 But we don’t stop at client impact. We are equally passionate about investing in our people. In S\&T, you’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands\-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. You'll have the opportunity to work across industries, engage directly with senior client stakeholders, and develop expertise at the intersection of strategy, AI, and business transformation.
   

  

 If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real\-world impact and where your growth matters as much as your clients’ Strategy \& Transactions is your next move.
   

  

**The team**
* Our Strategy practice brings together business strategists, AI specialists, data scientists, engineers, and transformation advisors to help clients move from AI ambition to measurable enterprise value. We work with clients to identify where AI can create advantage, shape AI and data strategy, design scalable operating models, and partner with technical teams to bring priority AI and data science initiatives to life.


 Strategy professionals serve as trusted advisors to our clients, helping them make clear, data\-driven choices about where to play, how to win, and how to scale AI responsibly across the enterprise.
   

  

**Work you will do:**
 Deloitte’s ‘Strategy’ offering helps companies address the entire range of top management challenges including pursuing new growth opportunities, developing go\-to\-market strategies, and driving enterprise transformation. As an AI Strategy Consultant, you will:
   

  

* Provide strategic directions to clients on how to leverage Artificial Intelligence (including Generative AI) to drive innovation, competitive advantage, and enterprise value.
* Work with C\-suite stakeholders to define AI strategy, vision, and transformation roadmaps, aligned to business priorities and market context.
* Identify and prioritize high\-impact AI and GenAI use cases, develop business cases, and define value realization pathways.
* Bring a strong understanding of how AI solutions are developed and deployed in enterprise environments to ground strategic recommendations in practical feasibility.
* Own the end\-to\-end product lifecycle for AI features from problem framing and requirements definition through sprint delivery, UAT, launch, and post\-launch iteration.
* Define detailed product requirements for AI/ML features specifying model inputs/outputs, confidence thresholds, fallback behaviors, latency requirements, and human\-in\-the\-loop escalation paths.
* Understand, decide and communicate business and technical decisions and trade\-offs and decisions to client stakeholders.
* Support clients in shaping AI\-enabled products, services, and business models, including commercialization and go\-to\-market considerations.
* Redesign customer and operational workflows by embedding AI into business processes and decision\-making.
* Partner with data scientists and ML engineers to define data schemas, feature requirements, and evaluation frameworks; contribute to decisions on model selection, fine\-tuning vs. prompting, and deployment approach.
* Support the planning and execution of AI transformation initiatives by coordinating cross\-functional teams, managing stakeholder alignment, tracking key milestones, and helping drive delivery of business outcomes.


**Required Experience And Skills**
**Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy (AI Strategy)**
* – Experience in defining AI strategies, identifying high\-value use cases, and building value creation roadmaps aligned to business priorities.
* – Ability to translate business problems into AI/GenAI opportunities, including use case identification, feasibility assessment, and ROI estimation.
* – Exposure to GenAI concepts (e.g., LLMs, copilots, intelligent automation) and their application across business functions.
* \- Understanding data foundations required for scalable AI adoption, AI/ML algorithm development workflow and data analysis, time\-series analysis, computer vision with an emphasis on generative AI and Large Language Models
* – Experience owning AI\-powered features end\-to\-end, including writing PRDs for ML systems, managing AI product backlogs, and coordinating delivery across product, engineering, and data science.
* – Experience supporting technology, data, analytics, automation, or AI\-enabled initiatives in a professional setting, with the ability to apply this understanding to real\-world enterprise constraints, delivery considerations, and change adoption.


**Core Consulting**
* Clear and concise communication \- conduct client interviews, participate in workshops/trainings and present recommendations.
* Lead product discovery sessions, write and refine requirements with engineering, run sprint reviews, and communicate AI system behavior and limitations to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Good client presence – interact and build relationships with clients and other team members.
* Analytical thinking \- ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary). Synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data.
* Logical structuring \- structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems.
* Deadline\-oriented and quality focused \- develop and own development of deliverables. own and manage specific work\-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources.
* Collaboration \- Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate.
* Networking \- Ability to chart one’s own career and build networks within the organization.


**Qualifications**
**Required:**
* MBA from a premier institution in India or abroad
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (B.Tech), preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related disciplines
* 4\+ years (for Senior Consultants) of relevant experience in roles involving AI strategy, AI product management, AI\-enabled digital transformation, data \& AI initiatives, or enterprise programs focused on leveraging Artificial Intelligence (including Generative AI) to drive business value
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, stakeholder management, and analytical skills
* Ability to work effectively with business stakeholders, data scientists, AI engineers, and product teams.


**Preferred:**
* Prior consulting, strategy, transformation, product management, or technology advisory experience
* Exposure to AI strategy, Generative AI, AI operating models, AI governance, AI product development, or AI transformation programs
* Experience working with global stakeholders and cross\-functional teams
* Familiarity with cloud, data, analytics, and AI ecosystems (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Relevant certifications in AI, Data, Cloud, or Analytics (e.g., Azure AI Fundamentals, Azure Data Fundamentals, AWS AI/ML certifications, Google Cloud AI certifications, Power BI, Tableau, TOGAF, or equivalent)


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Recruiting tips**
 From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

 The
 **Technical Project Lead**

title: Growth Manager (D2C)
description:
\[
 **Apply with the Excel sheet at the bottom]**
 Blue Dot Transform Consulting is a private limited company based out of pune. It works in multiple domain \- training \& Coaching, e\-commerce, alternative healing modalities.
   

  

 For the e\-commerce brand \- Divine Heals, we are currently hiring a growth manager.
   

  

 Divine Heals is a D2C spiritual products brand — The brand sells crystals, Rudraksha, essential oils, and combination bracelets, with a post\-purchase journey designed to move customers into Charu's coaching programmes.
   

  

 The brand is live, growing, and generating revenue. What it does not yet have is an operational system that can scale without the founder or the business head being pulled into execution daily.
   

  

 This role exists to build that system — and then run it.
   

 You will own the full operations function of Divine Heals.
   

  

 Shopify, fulfillment, inventory, post\-purchase flows, WhatsApp automation, SOPs, vendor management, customer experience, and the backend processes that make the business work without someone manually holding everything together.
   

  

 The marketing strategy and content are handled. Charu remains the face of the brand. Your job is to make sure everything behind the face works.
   

  

 What you will own
   

  

 Shopify and store operations
   

  

 Product page quality — descriptions, imagery formatting, size guides, care instructions, trust elements
   

  

 Inventory management — stock tracking, reorder triggers, low\-stock alerts
   

  

 Checkout experience — friction reduction, GoKwik integration performance, cart abandonment flows
   

 New product launches — end\-to\-end coordination from product briefing to live listing
   

  

 Pricing and offer architecture — seasonal promotions, bundle logic, prepaid incentives
   

 Fulfilment and logistics
   

  

 Shadowfax and XpressBees coordination — daily dispatch, exception handling, return management
   

 Shipping policy — SLA adherence, delay communication to customers, escalation handling
   

  

 COD to prepaid conversion — building incentive structures and checkout nudges to shift the ratio
   

 Customer experience
   

  

 Post\-purchase WhatsApp sequence — building and managing the 14\-day nurture flow in Charu's voice that moves buyers toward the Level I coaching programme
   

  

 Query handling SOP — standard responses, escalation paths, response time standards
   

 Review and testimonial system — collection, verification, and deployment across Shopify and social
   

  

 Automation and systems
   

  

 WhatsApp automation via QuickReply.ai — flows, triggers, campaign sequences
   

  

 Email marketing — post\-purchase drip, product education sequences, seasonal campaigns via whatever tool is in use
   

  

 CRM or tracking system — building a basic customer record so follow\-up is systematic, not memory\-based
   

 SOPs and documentation
   

  

 Every operational process documented — written down, version\-controlled, and accessible to the team
   

 Onboarding new team members into the Divine Heals operational workflow
   

  

 Monthly operations report — inventory status, fulfilment metrics, customer satisfaction indicators, open issues
   

  

  

  

 What we are looking for
   

 Non\-negotiable
   

  

 4\-5 years of hands\-on D2C operations experience — you have worked inside a D2C brand and you know what it takes to run one, not just advise one
   

 Shopify proficiency — you can manage products, collections, discounts, apps, and basic theme edits without needing a developer for everything
   

 Experience building or managing post\-purchase flows — WhatsApp, email, or both
   

 SOPs mindset — you document what you build. If it only exists in your head, it does not exist.
   

  

  

  

 Strong advantage
   

  

 Experience in spiritual, wellness, or lifestyle D2C categories — you understand the customer and the purchase psychology
   

  

 Familiarity with QuickReply.ai or similar WhatsApp business automation tools
   

  

 Experience managing logistics partners — Shadowfax, XpressBees, Shiprocket, or equivalent
   

 Understanding of COD\-heavy D2C operations in India — prepaid conversion strategies, RTO reduction, return management
   

  

 Experience with GoKwik or similar checkout optimisation tools

title: Technical Quote Lead – Displays
description:

 Visteon is a technology company that develops and builds innovative digital cockpit and electrification products at the leading\-edge of the mobility revolution. To know more about us click here .

 The Technical Quote Leader is responsible for leading new business pursuits/quotes for the Display product line and coordinating with all Display Product Line functions (Customer Regional Engineering, Mechanical, Display \& Lens teams, Hardware \& Platform Software teams, Program \& Commodity Purchasing and Manufacturing) and lead \& coordinate associated internal engineering activities.  Technical lead of Display related engineering activities for Customer RFIs \& Quotations: Lead multi\-functional global engineering internal team to Establish \& direct engineering team supporting pursuits/quotes within the Displays Product Line.

 Multiple internal cross\-functional stakeholders (example: sales, manufacturing, engineering); OEM customers; strategic suppliers.

* Technology Leadership : Introduce cutting\-edge technologies to drive product and feature competitiveness.

**Key experience required:**
* Years of Experience: 3\+ years of Automotive Display product experience or similar;
* Degree Strongly Preferred: Bachelor of Science (minimum), in Mechanical, Displays, or Electronic Engineering (EE), or a related field with equivalent experience.


**Desired Competencies/Experience:**
* Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously;
* Flexibility to support regions/countries in different time zones;
* Proven ability to lead and manage multi\-functional global engineering internal team .
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with global cultural sensitivity.
* Strong presentation skills;
* Ability to understand, at a high level mechanical, display design, electronics \& associated implementation;
* Good MS Office skills (Excel, Word, PowerPoint);
* Good communication skills especially with Customers;
* Ability to work within a constrained deadline (quotes are tight and time\-bound);
* Ability to work closely with suppliers for part selections and negotiations;
* A Plus – deep understanding of displays \& touch technology;
* A Plus –understanding of commercial/business/financial measurement (NPV, IRR, EBIT, etc.);
* A Plus – experience with Jira, Confluence and AI agents
* Fluent in English;
* Self\-motivated with the ability to lead a global team toward a common goal.
* Special Requirements (i.e. overtime, travel, etc.): Domestic and international travel to internal and customer locations may be required (\~5\-10%).


**Key Behaviors:**
* Collaboration;
* Result – oriented;
* Critical thinking;
* Evaluating problems;


**Reporting Structure:** 
 Reports to the Associate Manager of the Display Quote team.
   

  

**In the fast** 
 lane of technology. At Visteon, we’re redefining how the world connects through its vehicles. Our innovations transform the driving experience for millions, powered by a high\-performance culture that challenges the status quo and sparks new possibilities—in careers and communities. Join us and help shape the future.

description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
 Job Category
   

  

 Customer Success
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

 As an Engagement Delivery Director, you are a senior individual contributor and a foremost expert in delivering intended business value from the Salesforce platform. This is a fully\-billable, high\-impact role deployed as a Delivery Leader to our strategic and complex customer engagements.
   

  

 You will be responsible for the end\-to\-end success of programs, with a primary focus on maximizing platform adoption, demonstrating ROI, and mitigating revenue or license attrition risk. You will ensure that emerging capabilities, including agentic and generative AI programs, are delivered on time, within budget, and with a strict focus on quantifiable business outcomes.
   

  

 You will act as the key strategic advisor and point of accountability, building trust with executive stakeholders and ensuring the customer's long\-term success on the platform.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
* Program Accountability: Assume ultimate accountability for establishing, executing and overseeing program governance to deliver strategic value\-realization and recovery plans for strategic customer accounts, ensuring clear governance frameworks for complex multi\-cloud and enterprise AI implementation roadmaps.
* Executive Stakeholder Management: Engage directly with C\-level stakeholders to build trust, define success metrics, and demonstrate measurable platform ROI. You will lead all executive stakeholder forums, like Steering Committees, focusing heavily on Performance Evaluation \& ROI to help customers quantify the financial and operational business value of their AI investments.
* Strategic Advisory: Serve as the primary, billable expert providing strategic oversight to ensure program delivery aligns with the customer's core business objectives.
* Risk \& Scope Management: Proactively identify, assess, and manage program risks, dependencies, and scope changes. You will own the executive\-level escalation process and translate complex technical issues—such as AI compliance, data readiness, and security boundaries—into clear business implications.
* Commercial Acumen: Lead and support pre\-sales teams in initial scoping, change management, and identifying opportunities for expansion of the running program, accurately sizing the organizational change management and delivery effort required for generative AI and digital agent rollouts.
* Delivery Governance: Define, structure, and oversee complex engagement models (e.g., T\&M, Fixed Price), ensuring all delivery commitments, milestones, and scope are meticulously managed. You will champion an AI\-First Delivery \& Engineering methodology from a management perspective, tracking program health, team velocity, and delivery efficiency.
* Cross\-Functional Influence: Provide expert guidance and strategic direction to customer, partner (SI), and internal teams (e.g., MuleSoft, UI/UX, technical PODs) to ensure cohesive and successful program outcomes.
* Subject Matter Expertise: Act as a deep subject matter expert on the Salesforce platform, including new products, industry trends, and best\-practice implementation strategies involving custom development, integration, and data migration.
* Contract Management: Prior experience in understanding and working with MSA/SOW and ensuring delivery is compliant to the terms laid out there.

title: Product Manager
description:
HackerOne is a global leader in Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). The HackerOne Platform unites agentic AI solutions with the ingenuity of the world’s largest community of security researchers to continuously discover, validate, prioritize, and remediate exposures across code, cloud, and AI systems. Through solutions like bug bounty, vulnerability disclosure, agentic pentesting, AI red teaming, and code security, HackerOne delivers measurable, continuous reduction of cyber risk for enterprises. Industry leaders, including Anthropic, Crypto.com, General Motors, Goldman Sachs, Lufthansa, Uber, UK Ministry of Defence, and the U.S. Department of Defense, trust HackerOne to safeguard their digital ecosystems. HackerOne was recognized in Gartner’s Emerging Tech Impact Radar: AI Cybersecurity Ecosystem report for its leadership in AI Security Testing and has been named a Most Loved Workplace for Young Professionals (2024\).
   

  

 HackerOne is at a pivotal inflection point in the security industry. Offensive security is no longer optional – it is the standard for forward\-thinking companies that want to build trust and resilience in a world where AI\-driven innovation and adversaries are moving faster than ever. With the industry shifting, HackerOne stands apart: we combine the ingenuity of the largest security research community with a best\-in\-class AI\-powered platform, trusted by the world’s top organizations.
   

  

**HackerOne Values**
 HackerOne is dedicated to fostering a strong and inclusive culture. HackerOne is
 **Customer Obsessed** 
 and prioritizes customer outcomes in our decisions and actions. We
 **Default to Disclosure** 
 by operating with transparency and integrity, ensuring trust and accountability. Employees, researchers, customers, and partners
 **Win Together** 
 by fostering empowerment, inclusion, respect, and accountability.
   

  

**Product Manager, Agentic Vulnerability Elimination**
 Location: Pune, India (In\-office)
   

  

 Working timing : UK Shift
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 HackerOne is seeking a hands\-on, technically curious Product Manager to join the team building Agentic Vulnerability Elimination (AVE). AVE is how HackerOne brings AI agents and human expertise together to validate, prioritize, and remediate vulnerabilities at scale. The agents do the heavy lifting on every finding, while our triage analysts and security researchers keep them accurate and trustworthy. In this role, you will drive improvements to the quality and performance of these agents and the harness they run in, working closely with our Pune triage and offensive security teams and partnering closely with product development teams based in India, the Netherlands, and the U.K.
   

  

 This is an ideal role for someone who is energized by AI, comfortable getting into the details of how an agent actually behaves, and motivated by close collaboration with the operators, security researchers, and customers who use and pressure\-test our products every day.
   

  

 This hybrid role is located in Pune, India, and reports to the Principal Product Manager for Agentic Vulnerability Elimination.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
 Success in the Product Manager role will be accomplished by delivering on the responsibilities below in alignment with the Values and Principles that define how we work at HackerOne:
   

  

* Lead the definition and delivery of improvements to AI agent quality, performance, and cost management across validation, prioritization, exploitation, deduplication, and remediation, balancing model capabilities, operational workflows, customer outcomes, and engineering tradeoffs.
* Own the evolution of the evaluation framework and agent harness, establishing scalable evaluation methodologies, quality gates, and feedback loops that improve agentic capabilities over time.
* Partner with triage, engineering, offensive security researchers, and product teams to align priorities, influence product direction, and translate operational workflows into scalable, AI\-driven product capabilities.
* Work closely with our offensive security researchers to validate exploitability, adversarially stress\-test agent decisions, and improve how the agents reason about real\-world attack scenarios.
* Partner with customer\-facing teams in EMEA and the US to join customer calls and understand user workflows, gather feedback, and keep agent improvements grounded in real\-world needs.
* Define the product health metrics for your area, design experimentation frameworks, and use evidence to make prioritization decisions that improve customer and business outcomes.
* Own significant product initiatives, independently defining problem statements, success metrics, and execution plans while influencing the broader product strategy alongside senior product leadership and partnering closely with development teams based in India, the Netherlands, and the U.K.
* Navigate ambiguous product problems where customer needs, AI capabilities, and security workflows are still emerging, bringing structure, prioritization, and clear execution plans to cross\-functional teams.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of product management experience, ideally on technical or AI/LLM products at high\-growth tech or SaaS companies.
* A track record of building products with close cross\-functional collaboration across engineering, design, and operations.
* Hands\-on experience with LLM\-based solutions, including prompting, evaluations, quality control, and the practical realities of building features on top of generative AI.
* Strong analytical skills and comfort working directly with data to define metrics, run experiments, and make decisions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build alignment among technical and operational staff.
* Experience working with distributed/async product development teams in different time zones.
* Based in Pune or willing to relocate, and able to work on\-site there on a hybrid basis.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Experience building agentic systems, evaluation pipelines, agent harnesses, or human\-in\-the\-loop workflows.
* Familiarity with cybersecurity, vulnerability management, DevSecOps, or bug bounty and penetration testing.
* Prior experience working closely with an operations or triage team, or directly with security researchers.
* Comfort with SQL or light scripting to pull and analyze your own data.


 Compensation Band
   

  

 INR 30\-37\.50 LPA
   

  

 Job Benefits:
   

  

* Health (medical, vision, dental), life, and disability insurance\*
* Equity stock options
* Retirement plans
* Paid public holidays and unlimited PTO
* Paid maternity and parental leave
* Leaves of absence (including caregiver leave and leave under CO's Healthy Families and Workplaces Act)
* Employee Assistance Program

title: Product Owner
description:
**Who We Are** 




 Ontic provides software that helps corporate and government security teams identify threats, assess risk, and respond faster to keep people and organizations safe. Its AI\-powered Connected Intelligence Platform unifies security operations and data into a centralized system of record, enabling organizations to conduct risk assessments, protect against workplace violence, and manage threats and incidents more efficiently. Fortune 500 companies and federal agencies rely on Ontic to support security programs such as executive protection, threat intelligence, and corporate investigations. Learn more at ontic.ai or follow us on LinkedIn.
 



  





 As a Product Owner at Ontic, you will work closely with Product Management, UX Design, QA, and Engineering to ensure product requirements are clearly defined, technically feasible, and delivered with high quality. This role is primarily focused on supporting current and upcoming product releases by creating clarity from ambiguity, maintaining backlog readiness, and enabling Engineering teams to execute efficiently throughout the software development lifecycle.
 



  





 You will serve as the primary Product representative supporting Engineering teams during active development and release. Success in this role requires strong analytical thinking, excellent communication skills, and the ability to drive alignment across cross\-functional teams. Success will be measured by the quality of requirements, backlog readiness, stakeholder alignment, and the team’s ability to deliver roadmap commitments predictably and on time.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* Partner closely with Product Managers to translate product strategy and roadmap initiatives into detailed feature requirements and user stories
* Collaborate with Engineering, UX, and QA teams to refine requirements, clarify business logic, and ensure readiness for development
* Own and manage the team backlog, ensuring priorities are clearly defined and aligned with business objectives
* Write detailed epics, user stories, workflows, and acceptance criteria
* Lead backlog refinement sessions and support sprint planning activities with Engineering teams
* Work directly with developers during implementation to answer questions, clarify requirements, and support delivery execution
* Partner closely with Engineering to identify delivery risks, dependencies, scope tradeoffs, and requirement gaps in the development lifecycle
* Monitor development progress and proactively address requirement issues that could impact release timelines, scope, or quality
* Participate actively in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, standups, retrospectives, and defect triage
* Ensure features are fully defined, dependencies are identified, and edge cases are considered prior to development
* Support Product Managers in gathering and synthesizing input from Client Success, Services, and Sales into clear requirements
* Support user acceptance testing, release readiness activities, and post\-release validation
* Continuously improve backlog quality, delivery processes, and cross\-functional collaboration



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 4\-6 years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or similar delivery\-focused product role supporting Agile software development teams
* Strong technical aptitude, including the ability to understand APIs, data flows, system configurations, permissions models, and integration requirements.
* Experience working closely with Agile Engineering teams in a SaaS, preferably B2B, software environment
* Strong experience writing detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, workflows, and functional requirements
* Proven ability to manage and prioritize a product backlog in a fast\-paced Agile environment
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail
* Technical aptitude and understanding of software development concepts and processes
* Experience with tools such as JIRA, Confluence, and product analytics platforms is preferred
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field preferred



  





**You Believe**
